He gets in touch with uncle Hiro Asano (Kings Cross bar The Stone Wall), sells ~$30M of gold through Victor Tollman and Armenian fence Ari, meets Craig Vermillion (Cabal vampire) and Anna Tilden of the Network, fights the Blood Riders (blood servants on bikes; media call him 'Starlight Rider'), is kidnapped by a Lyon Network assassin (Sebastian) and learns the other outworlder is held by the Lyon branch. He reveals magic to Emi first, then his family; reconciles partly with Kaito and Amy; negotiates a deal with the Network (spirit coins, core-free training, release of the other outworlder, his own loot rights). Farrah Hurin is found alive as the other outworlder (back from the dead via the Reaper's bargain with the World-Phoenix) held at a Lyon black site; a bomb destroys the Network jet (Keith Culpeper dies); Jason accepts Nirvanic Transfiguration to pass the sealed aperture into the Dimensional Fortress near Saint-Etienne and frees Farrah. Dawn reveals the Earth-Pallimustus magic link and the Builder/Purity invasion plan. Jason finally leaves on a 'walkabout' to train his aura and prepare, leaving Shade bodies with Farrah and Emi.
118.name: Book 4 - Summary (Jason's return to Earth)

119.content: Casselton Beach: Jason's hometown on the Mid-North Coast of New South Wales, Australia (tourist beach town). Casselton West Regional Hospital (closed ~15 years) is where he was born and where he reappears on Earth. Nearby: Castle Reach (new regional hospital, Garden Shores assisted living), Castle Bluff. Erika films 'Beachside Kitchen' at the boardwalk by the Surf Club; Shiro owns the caravan park; Vermillion later buys a house here; Jason's houseboat berths in the marina; the Asano estate between national parks is bought later (Hiro).
119.name: Casselton Beach

120.content: Jason's family on Earth: father Ken Asano (landscape architect, middle son; Old Spice and soil; divorced Cheryl a year before; later sells his land and joins Hiro's compound); mother Cheryl (Marie; realtor; 'you loved me but didn't like me'); sister Erika (older; celebrity chef of 'Beachside Kitchen'); brother-in-law Ian Evans (doctor); niece Emi Evans-Asano (12 in Book 4; Jason calls her 'Moppet'); brother Kaito (helicopter pilot/owner; married Jason's ex, Amy); Amy Asano (mayor of Casselton Regional Council; kids Hana and Jace); uncle Hiro (younger, black sheep, ex-lawyer, runs The Stone Wall bar), uncle Shiro (older, developer; son Koji, Toby), grandmother Yumi Asano (stern, Japanese), maternal Nanna Glenda Pottsworth (cured of Alzheimer's/cancer), maternal uncle Robbo, Great Aunt Marjory (religious). Hiro's friend Taika is a Māori bouncer who becomes a huge gold-rank player.
120.name: Asano Family (Earth)

121.content: Hiro Asano: Jason's uncle, black sheep with organised-crime ties; runs The Stone Wall bar in Kings Cross; reconnects with Jason, helps sell gold, becomes patriarch-planner of the Asano family compound (arrays, prosperity essence combo renewal+rune+balance; also vast, rune, magic essences). Taika Williams: huge Māori bouncer with high-pitched voice (named 'like the director'), family-security head; gets might + swift + bird (garuda) + wing essences (dragon/garuda hybrid, giant golden eagle form and birdman battle form); becomes one of the strongest people on Earth; later chosen (with Rufus) for the vampire campaign; eats popsicles; mentions Mario Kart.
121.name: Hiro Asano and Taika Williams (Earth)

122.content: Craig Vermillion: pale, dark-haired Cabal front man in Sydney; a 'Greater Vampire (Human, Araneid bloodline, bronze)' for ~70 years who feeds without killing; hates lesser vampires; 'the boogie man'. Befriends Jason ('a good friend and a very bad enemy' - Ned Kelly spirit), brokers deals with EOA and Network, owns a 1967 Maserati Ghibli (Jason stores it). Later turned to gold by feeding on vampire lords; in Book 12 lives in Jason's Slovakian vampire city and teaches fine aura control.
122.name: Craig Vermillion

123.content: The Cabal: oldest, reclusive magical power on Earth - 'old magic', vampires, things older than history; controls old money; tier-four members hibernate. It had angel-like messengers secretly among its leaders (Boris Ket Lundi/Ketland is a global leader and a messenger). Its vampire lords later split from it. The Cabal holds Russia and most of Africa. In Book 12, it stays out of the fight with the Jakaar pirates.
123.name: The Cabal

124.content: The Network: Earth's essence-magic society (~500 years old), founded by a mysterious language-and-face-changing outworlder who seeded secret societies with essences; maintains a global detection Grid for 'dimensional incursions' (proto-astral spaces lasting 43 hours with an Anchor Dimensional Entity; only one category-four ever). Branches (Sydney, Lyon, US, China...) have Directors and Steering Committees under an International Committee ('like the UN'). Uses 'category' for ranks, 'luminous' for holy, monster cores heavily (so most members stall before gold), spirit coins and quintessence (called affinity gems). Key people: Anna Tilden (Director, later Asano ambassador), Keith Culpeper, Ketevan Arziani, Gladys Erstweller (healer), Nigel Thornton, Koen Waters, Asya Karadeniz, Michael Aram, Miranda Ellis (traitor, killed). Engineers of Ascension (EOA): weaker transhumanist faction (drugs, tattoos, converted elites) preparing for revelation. The Network keeps rebranding (True Network, Grand Network...). Revealed to governments ~3 years before Book 4 ('terrorist readiness exercises').
124.name: The Network (Earth)

125.content: Annabeth 'Anna' Tilden: Network Sydney Director (category-1 executive, wife Susan who owns the Network's front art gallery); sharp, pragmatic; becomes a Steering Committee member and Jason's political consultant/unofficial Asano ambassador to the world in Books 4-13 ('Mrs Tilden'). Brother Terry Tilden is in Australian media relations. Her family is an old Network family.
125.name: Anna Tilden

126.content: Farrah Hurin was killed in Book 1; the Reaper let her go via a bargain with the World-Phoenix, and she arrived on Earth as a second outworlder (near the Saint-Etienne anomaly, France), accepted six gift evolutions at once, passed out and was captured by the Lyon branch's Adrien Barbou (EOA-linked) and held collared. Her outworlder ability Power Bond enhances a trusted person's abilities (works only with Jason). Flames: Ghost Fire Mystic (ghostly flame diagrams boosting fire), Boost, Rising Flames, Limit Break, Lava Cannon, obsidian armour/segmented sword. Escapes her cell, is recaptured, and is rescued by Jason in the Dimensional Fortress. Reaches silver (month ~28). Teaches Network recruits, advises Jason, hates Amy and Kaito jokingly.
126.name: Farrah Hurin - return (Book 4)

127.content: Dimensional Fortress: a permanent astral space near Saint-Étienne, France, found by the Lyon branch in 1948; heightened magic, DEs manifest directly, used as monster hunting reserve and spirit-coin farm, hidden from the Network for 70 years by faking the grid. Looks like dilapidated interconnected manors and crumbling castles in fog and drizzle. Adrien Barbou (Lyon Operations Director, wind user) sealed its two apertures; Paul Abreo (Lyon Steering Committee) confessed. Jason uses Nirvanic Transfiguration to pass the seals and free Farrah. In Book 11 this astral space becomes the second abnormal transformation zone; later Saint-Étienne holds Jason's cloud city.
127.name: Dimensional Fortress (Saint-Etienne)

128.content: Nirvanic Transfiguration (World-Phoenix blessing replacing Astral Affinity): body+soul gestalt; on lethal damage a nirvanic rebirth restores the full body once per rank increase; immune to other resurrection; aura much stronger; resists hostile dimension effects and disruptive damage; boosted dimension abilities and transcendent damage; physical reality around you stabilises; senses astral apertures and proto-astral spaces; can traverse sealed apertures. If discorporated with rebirth unavailable the soul stays spirit until diamond rank. Jason accepts it in Book 4: skeleton becomes silver metal, eyes silver and faintly glowing, hair lost again, three energy globes (Shade/Colin/Gordon) circle in his ribcage. Without his token he otherwise does not resurrect.
128.name: Nirvanic Transfiguration

129.content: Spirit Vault (Inventory evolved): dimensional storage Jason can enter, later a physical space others can enter only if they implicitly trust him. Seen as a floating obsidian gazebo with four arches (void exit; Colin; Shade; Gordon). Upgraded to a hanging garden: blood section like an artery, sin garden black/red/white/gold, dark underground cave with luminescent fungus, doom trees, a creek from the astral, fairy grotto, central 3-storey pagoda (inventory in starry void, sitting area, meditation room with white moss). Inside, others cannot use abilities; Jason and familiars can affect them. Emi and Farrah are the first to enter.
129.name: Spirit Vault

130.comment: The Dawn Paintings and Dawn's Revelations
130.content: Dawn (First Servant of the World-Phoenix) leaves two paintings in the Network's gallery (four pillars between two planets: Jason, Colin, Gordon, Shade; and 'The Invasion of Pallimustus', floating cities). In person (avatar) she tells Jason: a magical link siphons magic from Pallimustus to Earth (escalating over ~150 years); Earth's membrane (stronger than Pallimustus) will break when density crosses the iron threshold (~10 years if the Network keeps intercepting incursions), then weather, geology (~50 years) and total loss of integrity (~250 years). Cause: ~500 years ago an Earth outworlder served a Pallimustus deity (implied Knowledge), returned with tools to build the Network/grid; the Builder gave a deity techniques for the link. On Pallimustus delayed monster surges raise danger of diamond manifestations; the god Purity bargained with the Builder (Builder takes astral spaces, Purity rebuilds and cleanses). The old Builder created the universe seeds (Earth and Pallimustus) and was sanctioned. Jason must find and shut down the 'link enhancer'. Jason punches Dawn's avatar over Farrah and loots 10 diamond, 100 gold, 1,000 silver, 10,000 bronze, 100,000 iron spirit coins.
130.name: The Dawn Paintings and Dawn's Revelations

131.content: Earth's Network ranks: Category 0-5 = normal, iron, bronze, silver, gold, diamond. Cabal calls them tiers. Incursions (proto-astral spaces) have Dimensional Entities (DE) and an Anchor DE (ADE); standard collapse in 43 hours. Network mana lamps and affinity gems (quintessence) exist. Core-based advancement is the Network's main method; non-core training (Jason's teaching) is rare.
131.name: Earth Magic Ranks and Terms (Category)

132.content: Network people: Nigel Thornton ('Thorny', section leader, conjures guns; later joins Asano clan), Koen Waters (Sydney Director of Tactical Operations, strongest cat-3, Indigenous Australian), Tom Cotsworth (Adelaide DTO), Kylie Chen (bronze scout, dark+vision, records perceptions), Nigel's section: Darce, Jonno, Higgy, Orange, Green, Woolzy, Cobbo, Digit; Eustace Brown (Harvest director), Gladys Erstweller (cat-3 healer), Asya Karadeniz (IC magitech administrator; classmate of Jason; wants romance), Ketevan Arziani (Anna's right hand, later Asano chief of staff), Michael Aram (investigator), Sebastian (French assassin) and Remy (Lyon portal specialist, 1200 km range).
132.name: Taika's and Network Tactical Teams

133.comment: The Network's Betrayal: Miranda Ellis and Adrien Barbou
133.content: Miranda Ellis (Sydney Steering Committee, ex-Melbourne director) manipulated Kylie Chen to free Sebastian and conspired with Adrien Barbou: a bomb brings down the Network jet over the Indian Ocean (~15 km altitude): Keith Culpeper and most aboard die; Jason heals/rescues Ketevan, Asya, Aram and Bruce Corwin; an EOA superyacht attacks (silver rockets homing on Gordon). Jason kills EOA 'Number One' (Henri) and 'Number Two'; Number Three, Reynaldo Agostinelli, surrenders. Miranda is killed by Sebastian and Remy in Kakadu. (Note: an earlier note labels a 'Miranda' as recruiter in Book 3 epilogue.)
133.name: The Network's Betrayal: Miranda Ellis and Adrien Barbou

134.comment: Dorrigo and Other Incursions; Network Spirit Coins
134.content: Jason joins Network raids: a cat-3 incursion at Dorrigo National Park (jungle trolls, ogres, river hydras, giant toads) where Jason kills ADEs and shows Network teams adventurer tactics; the South Australia incursion (gigantoads, yowies, yara-ma-yha-who, barb-tailed mantas; spaces last 60 hours with Jason). He leaves 'Product of Jason, G'day mate' coins; secretly works at the Network's Sydney clinic as the 'Starlight Angel'. Jason's contract with the Network: loot rights, core-free training, family support.
134.name: Dorrigo and Other Incursions; Network Spirit Coins

135.comment: Erika, Ian and Emi gain essences
135.content: Family awakenings in Book 4: Erika - Feast, Knife, Dance -> Bounty confluence (Feeding the Multitudes, Gourmet & Gourmand, knife conjuration, dance telekinesis, imbue food with magic; world's first magic celebrity chef). Ian - Renewal, Life, Pure -> Ministration (healer; works at the Network clinic). Kaito - Vehicle, Wind, Swift -> Soaring (conjures a helicopter). Amy - gun/fire/lightning combination ('Thadwick Principle') later. Hiro - vast, rune, magic then renewal+rune+balance -> Prosperity. Taika - might, swift, bird, wing. Cheryl (mother): lotus confluence planned. Emi: protective/directing combination in ~3 years (she later gets Stash-like help; by Book 11 she has a confluence).
135.name: Erika, Ian and Emi gain essences

136.content: After Book 4, Jason spends a month retraining his aura with Farrah, Vermillion (fine control), the Mirror King's methods and Shade (aura masking), then leaves on a walkabout (Asia, Middle East, Africa per wiki timeline) with some Shade bodies, leaving one with Farrah and one with Emi. Emi: 'You have to come back.' Jason promises grand adventures later. Book 5 opens 1-2 months into the walkabout; the wiki dates the trip roughly to months 22-27 of the story.
136.name: Jason's aura retraining and walkabout

137.content: Sydney crime: Victor Tollman (big ex-Collingwood ruckman, throne room, Hiro's boss); Ari (Armenian gold fence, German Shepherds, aide Petros). EOA muscle under Michael Kissling (Elite Converted, bronze, white t-shirt drones). Blood Riders: 29 blood servants on motorbikes created by a Cabal vampire, Clinton, fronting for uncle Franklin; defeated by Jason and Vermillion; Cabal hands the culprit to the Network (6 civilians died).
137.name: Tollman, Ari and Sydney underworld

138.content: At Book 4's Ch10 status: Bronze, 25% to silver; Power(Blood) B3, Speed(Dark) B2, Spirit(Doom) B2, Recovery(Sin) B3; racial abilities Party Interface, Defiant, Spirit Vault, Tactical Map, Astral Affinity (then Nirvanic Transfiguration), Dark Rider; Dark: Midnight Eyes B5, Cloak of Night B4, Path of Shadows B4, Hand of the Reaper B2, Shadow of the Reaper B4; Blood: Blood Harvest B4, Leech Bite B4, Feast of Blood B3, Sanguine Horror B4, Haemorrhage B3; Sin: Punish B4, Feast of Absolution B4, Sin Eater B3, Hegemony B5, Castigate B4; Doom: Inexorable Doom B4, Punition B3, Blade of Doom B4, Verdict B2, Avatar of Doom B4. By Book 4's end Doom/Spirit hit Bronze 4.
138.name: Jason's Bronze status sheet (Book 4)

139.comment: Erika Asano's cooking show and Emi
139.content: Emi Evans-Asano: Jason's niece, 'Moppet'; quotes Laplace; first person he reveals magic to; sees Gordon/Colin/Shade; wants a motorcycle form; Jason promises to teach her. Erika's show 'Beachside Kitchen' (producer Wally) features Jason in dessert week with sunglasses ('eye condition').
139.name: Erika Asano's cooking show and Emi

140.comment: Spirit Vault - Jason's Earth Cloud Flask and Carriage House
140.content: On Earth the Cloud Flask needs a Vortex Accumulator (bronze: Magic essence + Gathering essence + 100 bronze vortex gems + 1000 bronze coins; Jason uses the silver version). Forms: cloud house (grand/adaptive), bronze carriage house (double-decked hover RV, license plate 'RPR-MAN'). Shade forms a black sports car (plates '5H4-D0W'), bikes, motorcycles and jet suits.
140.name: Spirit Vault - Jason's Earth Cloud Flask and Carriage House

141.comment: Michael Aram, Wally, Greg and Casselton friends
141.content: Greg: Jason's school friend (law, Sydney) who later receives essences via Asya and learns everything. Wally: Erika's producer. Silas: school acquaintance. Mrs Wilkins: Emi's academy receptionist.
141.name: Michael Aram, Wally, Greg and Casselton friends

142.comment: Book 5 - Summary (Walkabout, the Grid fails, Makassar, silver rank, Gerling, Kaito dies)
142.content: BOOK 5 (Earth, ~9 months after Jason's return; his birthday is April 1, he turns 26): Jason travels Asia/Africa curing Ebola camps (Dr Chloe Baudrillard), fighting incursions, and becomes the 'Starlight Angel/Rider'. The Network's Grid is sabotaged by the Engineers of Ascension (EOA; Four Cardinals Mr North, Mrs West, Mrs South/Audrey Blaine, Mr East/Adrien Barbou) and goes down worldwide; monsters pour out (Angola mine first). Asano Village (the family clifftop compound) is built. Shade reaches silver (31 bodies). Dawn returns repeatedly in avatars. Broken Hill is overrun (EOA 'League of Heroes' infiltrate; ~12-15k dead, ~19k saved by Jason's Shade buses and portals); Jason humiliates the EOA media team on camera. Makassar (Indonesia) suffers a category-4 incursion: Jason and Akari fight dino-men and the Dinosaur King; Jason dies and resurrects as a Star Phoenix, kills the King (title Giant Slayer). Jason reaches Silver on the helipad. He fights ~200,000 Makassar undead. He travels to Japan: the Asano clan (Shiro, Noriko, Mei, Akari) and the Tiwari clan guard THE DOOR (Fundament Gate); Jason absorbs it in the Fundamental Realm, defeating Mr North's lure. Reality cores and node space: Jason begins repairing the Earth-Pallimustus link nodes. Transformation events begin (Kostroma, Pudong...). The US Network's Jack Gerling (gold) captures Akari, Mei and Itsuki and kills Kaito, Asya and Greg. Funeral for Kaito. Jason and Farrah raid reality cores and fight Cabal vampires (Lord Willoughby, Sydney HQ attack). Book ends with Jason heading into the Slovakian transformation zone (dimensional ulceration) near Nitra.
142.name: Book 5 - Summary (Walkabout, the Grid fails, Makassar, silver rank, Gerling, Kaito dies)

143.content: Shade reaches silver in Book 5 with 31 bodies; can teleport any body to any other, act as medium for Jason's non-combat abilities (shadow-jump, perception), wear starlight cloaks (vehicles gain cloak properties), form five bullet-train-like buses, a stealth plane, jet suits, motorbikes, cars. Shade's father is the Reaper (death). Shade often 'butlers' for Jason ('Alfred to Batman'). Gordon's silver vessel: cloak with nebula, six orbs of either beam type; Colin's silver vessel: humanoid in dark-red leather cloak with Jason's face, explodes into leeches; Sanguine Raiment.
143.name: Shade - silver and spreading

144.content: Asano Village: Jason's family compound built in ~6 months on clifftop land between national parks near Casselton, NSW (Australia) by Ken (earth shaping, plant growth), Hiro (logistics), Farrah (arrays/formations: ideograph fence wire, mana-draining lightning fence), Emi and Taika. Eco village with gathering halls, food court, spa, medical centre (Ian, Yumi, Gladys), Network office, 3-storey pub with cinema, 'Mayor's House' (Erika is mayor), bushland/beach/clifftop pods, secret tramway tunnels and a glass undersea tunnel to a dome where Jason's cloud house sits. Later hidden from the world; the Asano clan evacuates to Europe via Jason's spirit domains. In Book 11-12 the Australian government seizes Jason's land (eminent domain) and gives it to the Japanese 'true' Asano clan (Noriko).
144.name: Asano Village (Earth)

145.comment: Makassar Incursion and the Dinosaur King
145.content: Makassar (South Sulawesi, 1.5 million people): a category-3 proto-space and then a category-4 one (gold anchor). Dino-men (silver intelligent lizard-men: Silha, Kowal, Chesh, Loth) lead dinosaur monsters; the King is a gold dino-man less than two days old who plans to 'carve a place from their flesh'. Jason enters alone, destabilises apertures, is killed by the King, revives as a Star Phoenix, and annihilates the dying King with Verdict. Loot: Title Giant Slayer, Armour of the Dinosaur King (gold; later a gift to Asano clan), Soul-Imprinting Triune, large coin stacks. Global death toll over 150,000 in 8 days. Later ~200,000 undead 'Butterflies of Makassar' (raised by an old EOA/Cabal researcher) are destroyed with Silver afflictions (Blood From a Stone, Mortality, Weakness of the Flesh) and Gordon's Harbinger of Doom.
145.name: Makassar Incursion and the Dinosaur King

146.content: Broken Hill, NSW (pop ~20k; ~35k with refugees): EOA League of Heroes infiltrate, cut comms, a category-3 proto-space opens; ~12-15k die (5th-largest single loss of life); Jason's Shade buses and portals save ~19k. On camera Jason confronts EOA media team (Penelope, Garret 'Skybolt' Dunhurst, Davina), shoots Davina to show she is enhanced, and gives a speech: 'If you want heroes, go digging through the rubble.' Network becomes GDN (Global Defense Network) publicly.
146.name: Broken Hill

147.content: EOA (Engineers of Ascension) leadership: Mr North (true leader; very old, gold-rank, not fully human; formerly bonded to the Network founder's rune-spider familiar and betrayed the founder in colonial days), Mrs West, Mrs South (Audrey Blaine, killed/replaced; she is cloned and defects), Mr East (originally an exaggerator; replaced by Adrien Barbou). Plan: disable the Grid, trigger monster waves, and transform society; use the Builder's clockwork-core converted. Mr North tries to lure Jason in the Fundamental Realm and asks him to join EOA ('the day will come when you and I become allies').
147.name: EOA Four Cardinals

148.comment: The Door / Fundament Gate and Node Space
148.content: The Door (Fundament Gate): a legendary transcendent door guarded for centuries by the Tiwari clan in Japan (originally from India, brought by the Network founder) that opens onto the templates (building blocks) the original Builder used to make the universe; Jason absorbs it into his Spirit Vault in Japan (legendary; improves sensing/resisting Builder items; Path of Shadows can open a portal to the Fundamental Realm). Node space: silver-light cube landscape where reality cores (ostrich-egg-sized dark crystals with transcendent light) are the mechanism; Jason adjusts the link nodes. Itsuki Tiwari (20, bronze, dark/blood/omen -> Doom confluence, fanboy; uncles Denji (patriarch) and Souta, father Koya) apprentices with Jason. Prophecy: 'When monsters walked the world, a man of two worlds would close the door forever.'
148.name: The Door / Fundament Gate and Node Space

149.comment: Asano Clan (Japan) and Akari, Mei, Shiro, Noriko
149.content: Japanese Asano clan (Ashiya near Kobe, Frank Lloyd Wright-designed compound; shares an ancestor with Jason's family in early Edo): Akari (silver, chokutō, swordmaster with Master confluence sword+adept+magic, blink teleports; sent to assess Jason), her younger sister Mei (silver healer), patriarch Shiro (silver, father; unlike Noriko moderates; after the coup lives at Asano Village), and grandmother Noriko (near-peak silver, strongest; ousts Shiro and later hosts the pirate captain Jota). Noriko votes to seize the door by force; Jason cuts all ties ('If we meet again, as enemies').
149.name: Asano Clan (Japan) and Akari, Mei, Shiro, Noriko

150.content: Jack Gerling: huge bear-like US Network category-4 (gold): might, potent, vast = Onslaught; explosion-flight, void gravity sphere, Immortality. Kept in stasis with gold coins until Emerson Cleary (US Network Deputy Director) wakes him with a reality core to take control of Jason's node project. Gerling captures Akari, Mei and Itsuki, kills Kaito Asano, Asya Karadeniz and Greg (Jason cannot beat him yet), then later trains to rematch; later he shows up in Nitra (Book 5 end) and in Book 6+ stays a recurring figure. Jason promises Asya not to fight Gerling.
150.name: Jack Gerling and Emerson Cleary

151.content: In Austria, Gerling kills Jason's brother Kaito (helicopter pilot), Asya Karadeniz (Network International Committee rep, Jason's love interest) and Greg (school friend). Funeral for Kaito in winter; Jason attends unseen; Amy: 'I hate you for taking him.' Dawn arranges with the Cult of the Reaper that Shade serve as a vessel for ghost-like projections of the three for nine hours one time only (no afterlife talk): Kaito apologises for the Amy betrayal and tells Jason to be the TV-obsessed Jason, not a dead-eyed killer; Asya says 'I love you... high maintenance'; Greg gives a chuuni speech. The three ritual circles use diamond coins.
151.name: Kaito, Asya and Greg's deaths

152.comment: Cabal vampires: Lord Willoughby, Franklin, Nathaniel
152.content: Bankstown (Sydney) is transformed into a volcanic stone city (people become Smoulder). Ancient vampire Lord Willoughby (hibernating since 1794, gold-rank servitor bloodline, mad colonial) leads a Cabal assault on the Network's Sydney HQ (ghouls, lesser vampires, ~200+ dead). Jason, Farrah and Dawn kill/bind him; a 2 m hole from the 8th floor to the lobby remains (Gordon). Franklin (Cabal vampire, century-old) and Nathaniel (ogre) help Craig; Bryan 'Night Stalker' Slansky is a dominus-bloodline plant killed by Craig and Franklin. Craig defects from the Cabal's old guard.
152.name: Cabal vampires: Lord Willoughby, Franklin, Nathaniel

153.content: When Earth's grid is off and the membrane degrades, a proto-space sphere seals a city for 43 hours; afterwards buildings are rewritten in alien style and the people become other species: Kostroma (Russia) -> mostly leonids; Pudong (China) -> crystal city of gemstone-scale earth-affinity people; Bankstown (Sydney) -> Smoulder; Coconut Grove (Miami) -> elves; Detroit area -> goblins; Cabal gets centaurs, ogres, fairies. Each event leaves a reality core. Dawn: celestines are children of two outworlders. Death toll over 2 million by Book 5 Ch45. Transformed people are essence-capable.
153.name: Transformation Events (Book 5)

154.content: At silver Jason: Midnight Eyes Silver 0 (read auras, aura senses overload), Cloak of Night Silver 0 (flight, space distortion), Path of Shadows Silver 0 (portal one silver-ranker, 800 km; later 1600 km), Hegemony Silver 0 (wider; transcendent damage downgraded), Feast of Absolution Silver (area), Sin Eater Silver, Blade of Doom Silver (silver sword, Penitent form), Punition Silver (scalable cost), Punish Silver 2 (Wages of Sin), Blood Harvest Silver 2 (Blood Frenzy/Blood of the Immortal), Verdict. He no longer needs to breathe, eat or use his vocal cords much. Spirit Vault silver: Asian/European interconnected buildings, central 4-sided pagoda. Jason ranks to Silver on the helipad of the Mayor's House at Asano Village (purge phase).
154.name: Jason's Silver Rank (Book 5)

155.content: Dawn speaks to Jason through normal-rank 'avatars' that she cannot sustain long; Jason punches the first to death and loots her coins; she returns in silver avatars (rainbow light) and wears a white dress with orange and yellow. She lives in Asano Village studying astral magic with Jason, helps with books Knowledge gave him, and plans the Earth link repair. Her authority is dimensional integrity.
155.name: Dawn on Earth (avatars)

156.comment: Nitra and the Slovakia zone (Book 5 end)
156.content: Nitra (western Slovakia) is the Network's centre after vampires push it from Bratislava. Book 5 ends as Jason enters a sealed glimmering dome several km across (rainbow under glass): a transformation zone in a space already coterminous with a proto-space, an 'open wound' in the universe (dimensional ulceration). Dawn: best case a second uncuttable magic source; worst case annihilation of Earth or the solar system. This leads to Book 6's Slovakia zone and, later, Jason's Slovakian vampire astral space with a permanent night.
156.name: Nitra and the Slovakia zone (Book 5 end)

157.content: Emi (13) is a better ritualist than many Network members and trains under Farrah in formations/arrays; after Kaito's death she tells Jason she doesn't want to be an adventurer or kill things. Erika is mayor of Asano Village, Ian runs operations/medical, Yumi medical admin, Ken land, Hiro magical infrastructure.
157.name: Emi (Book 5) and Erika's compound role

158.content: After Jason's visit, Noriko ousts Shiro in a Kobe-branch-backed coup; Shiro and his daughters plus Tiwari exiles (Koya, Denji) move to Asano Village. Itsuki is left behind with Akari.
158.name: Akari Asano's clan politics

159.content: After Makassar and the failing of the Grid, the Network splits into Chinese-aligned, US (no allies) and the Global Defence Network (GDN, largest/least stable; world governments work with it). GDN publicly ends association with Jason (Ch43) as 'radicalised'. About 19 countries consider divesting. The US Network wakes cat-4s in stasis.
159.name: Makassar aftermath: global reaction

160.comment: Book 6 - Summary (Slovakia zone, Shako, Saint-Etienne, Jason leaves Earth)
160.content: BOOK 6: Jason enters the Slovakian transformation zone near Nitra (genesis space: essence abilities don't work, only racial gifts). He expands a spirit domain through territories (Arrival Pagoda, Soul Haven, Tranquil Shadow Woods, Steamforge Circuit...), using Stable Genesis Cores and Genesis Reclamation Cores; Dread Salvation becomes a sealed bronze growth sword; the Soul-Imprinting Triune binds Amulet of the Dark Guardian, Cloud Flask and Dread Salvation into the Regalia of the Dark Hegemon. Gold-rankers Gerling, Chen, Guo and Tran enter; Tran becomes a vampire-anomaly (Jason uses his True Light); Guo is later transformed by unstable cores. Jason gains the title Reality Hegemon and consolidates the zone into a permanent astral space (Jason's Slovak spirit domain). Shako appears and kills Jason; Dawn arrives in her true body and negotiates with the Builder: Jason will get a Fundament-Gate-based bridge item. Jason obtains Firmament Bridge, the Eye of Doom, the Vessel of the Hegemon. He and Farrah, with Travis Noble, steal a US SADM sun-weapon and destroy the vampires' hub in the astral space near Saint-Etienne; Shako's device and Gerling cause a second transformation zone there; Jason claims it, adopts Mr North (Noreth), the Necromancer (Todd Halverson) and ancient vampires as allies, defeats a nightmare hag, kills Gerling and Noreth, and stabilises the zone into his Saint-Etienne spirit domain. He then leaves Earth on a warm autumn day with Farrah. Epilogues: Gary becomes a blacksmith with Virid Martine; Sophie, Humphrey, Neil, Clive, Belinda learn of the Order/Cult of the Reaper and are ordered into the monster surge; Dawn asks Gary to reforge Dread Salvation.
160.name: Book 6 - Summary (Slovakia zone, Shako, Saint-Etienne, Jason leaves Earth)

161.content: Regalia of the Dark Hegemon: the soul-bound growth set Amulet of the Dark Guardian (Hegemon's Authority: allies resist aura suppression), Cloud Flask (shrinks into a pendant; mist cloud steps; palace form at silver) and Dread Salvation (Hegemon's Tribute: mild ongoing mana drain on struck enemies in his aura; burst on cleanse/death). In Book 6 Dread Salvation becomes a sealed bronze growth sword imbued with aura; later warped by Shako and reforged by Gary in Book 6's epilogue/Book 7.
161.name: Regalia of the Dark Hegemon

162.content: Transformation zone mechanics: a sealed dome for 43+ hours; inside is a genesis space where essence abilities, aura and perception are sealed (racial gifts remain). Anomalies are shape-shifting monsters (silver/gold) born from the strongest presence and memories. Defeating them yields Stable Genesis Cores (expand a spirit domain; first claimed territory costs 1 core, later 26-78+), Unstable Genesis Cores (dangerous; Guo/Tran), Dark/Sin/Doom/Blood orbs (unseal an essence ability), Genesis Reclamation Core (drains energy from reality cores and those who consumed them, makes a Regenesis Core). Claiming territories shows 'severity reduction' (like a loading bar) toward stabilising; defeating a greater anomaly claims a territory (e.g., Arrival Pagoda, Soul Haven, Steamforge Circuit). Hostile players' domains contest borders. At 100% the zone stabilises into a permanent astral space and the dome vanishes, leaving an alien landscape and a reality core.
162.name: Genesis Space and Transformation Zones (mechanics)

163.comment: Arrival Pagoda and Jason's Slovak Spirit Domain
163.content: Arrival Pagoda: first claimed territory (a dilapidated hotel becomes an octagonal residential pagoda with waterfall atrium; 10 portal arches to the astral space; administration, residential and bedroom floors). Territories: Soul Haven (cloud-stuff city, sun rises), Tranquil Shadow Woods, Steamforge Circuit (industrial ring), a retro-future city, a spy-movie Prague, etc. The astral space consolidated into a steampunk spoked-wheel city 18 km across (outer ring 160 km; 700 km explorable). Hostile intruders suffer Blood From a Stone, Mortality, Weakness of the Flesh, Sin and Wages of Sin that ignore rank; domain kills are consumed and looted to his vault; those who venerate him get afflictions converted to Integrity. Max domain ~3266% of his allowance. Nikoleta's family of transformed celestines are taken to Soul Haven. Jason annexes ~26 km2 of Slovakia. Later Craig Vermillion leads vampires into the Slovak domain, which gets a permanent night city.
163.name: Arrival Pagoda and Jason's Slovak Spirit Domain

164.content: Reality Hegemon: title earned when Jason forces Hegemony's unsealing (domain effect on hostile intruders ignores rank disparity). Eye of Doom: transformed Doom Orb; spirit domains gain an extra doom passive; eyes become eye-shaped nebulas; can remotely view any place in domain. Vessel of the Hegemon: converts a vehicle/construct's interior into an extension of his spirit domain (the cloud flask turns nebula-eye form). Battle trance: state taught by Rufus and Farrah where he reacts perfectly.
164.name: Reality Hegemon (title)

165.comment: Gold-rankers in the Slovak zone (Chen, Guo, Tran, Gerling)
165.content: Li Li Mei (Chinese Network leader, silver) and her 'Uncle' Chen (gold, handsome, flight with light nimbus, bloody cauldron, bloodshot orb scouts, shield against abnormal dimensional effects) lead China's group; Guo (weakest, nepotism, Star Trek fan); Tran (Vietnamese boxer). Tran absorbs unstable cores, becomes a vampire-anomaly and is beheaded by Jason with True Light (diamond-rank consumable from the Reaper trials); Guo is turned into a three-storey sea anemone and killed. Chen later aids Shako and flees. Li Li Mei later joins Jason's travelling circle (travels with Farrah's team in Book 12).
165.name: Gold-rankers in the Slovak zone (Chen, Guo, Tran, Gerling)

166.content: Shako (diamond, Builder's servant/vessel) kills Jason in Book 6, violating the compact between the Builder, Reaper and World-Phoenix. Jason resurrects as a Star Phoenix. Dawn (true body: celestine, ruby gemstone hair and eyes, yellow robe with flame trim) negotiates: the Builder gives the Fundament Gate designs so the World-Phoenix can craft a complementary BRIDGE between Earth and Pallimustus anchored through Jason; when complete, Jason's ability to manipulate the fundamental realm is revoked; Dawn may go to Pallimustus (warn only); the Builder restricts attempts to kill Jason to when Jason seeks trouble, without pitting higher-ranks against him. Jason gets the bridge item (a ship-in-a-bottle) and later absorbs Firmament Bridge (transcendent legendary: astral bridge anchored in both nodes). Dawn takes his warped sword to Pallimustus.
166.name: Shako kills Jason; Dawn's negotiation

167.content: Travis Noble: 21 at Book 6, category-2 US magitech engineer (California), from a Network family older than the Revolutionary War; acting head of US Special Munition Stockpile; fanboy; 'Compensator' belt-fed revolver; modifies the stolen SADM into a sunlight-only vampire-killing nuke (Travis' Big Rocket after transformation). Joins Jason and Farrah, later marries Gabrielle, co-founds the Sky Link Company with Farrah and the Magic Research Association with Clive; lives in Rimaros; owns the Sea of Storms island. Ingrid is the base's security chief.
167.name: Travis Noble

168.content: Noreth (Mr North): the true leader of EOA and a rune spider, the Network founder's former familiar (named Noreth by the founder), older than the Network, not human; betrayed the founder to the US Network antecedents; built augmentation using modified clockwork cores from a destroyed Clockwork King found on Earth; disabled the Grid as a 'necessary evil' to unite humanity against a future enemy; tricks Jason; appears as Alexander Clerck; Jason lets him fight with them against the hag; Noreth dies in Book 6, killing Gerling and then himself, saying 'The welfare of the world must be the supreme law' (Salus mundi suprema lex esto). Left a hidden vault under Farrah's accumulator for Jason.
168.name: Mr North / Noreth

169.comment: The Necromancer (Todd Halverson) and the ancient vampires
169.content: The Necromancer: Todd 'the Necromancer' Halverson, silver human with Death essence (looting), purple coat, chuuni; the Makassar researcher; recruited by EOA; awakens 5 ancient gold vampires (Elizabeth, Klaus, Georges, Wassily and another); Jason grants him amnesty ('Nazi scientist deal'); dies from the Men-in-Black greater anomaly. Elizabeth (red gown, blood-ritual leader, escapes with a Blood Rebirth Crystal trick) later leads ancient vampires separate from the Cabal; Klaus dies (warped by vorger); Georges Albon is killed; Wassily is turned into an ogre anomaly. Élie (French) and Andrei (Russian) are two ancient gold vampires seen attacking the German airbase.
169.name: The Necromancer (Todd Halverson) and the ancient vampires

170.comment: Nightmare hag and the Men-in-Black zone
170.content: Nightmare hags: diamond-rank astral entities that feed on fear via illusions; once used by the Order of the Reaper. In Saint-Etienne's zone a hag holds Gerling's team in an illusion; Jason breaks free (title Indomitable) and kills the hag's victims with Travis' Big Rocket's sunlight. Vorger: incorporeal astral beings that warp flesh into abominations; need aura, soul attacks or disruptive force. A greater anomaly (a normal man in black with gadgets) kills Todd and destroys Gordon's vessel.
170.name: Nightmare hag and the Men-in-Black zone

171.content: Jason's Saint-Étienne spirit domain: whimsical French-film aesthetic encompassing most of the city, in one of Earth's highest magic zones (stronger than Greenstone). Established ~six months before Jason leaves; vampires abandoned France; the French interim government operates from it; Yumi Asano ('Dr Asano') administers the Transformed Relocation project with the UN; Anna is UN liaison. After the EOA collapses (funds siphoned, clockwork core source gone), Jason says the job is done: the membrane will recover over decades. Hiro manages relocation; Ken repairs devastated areas; Travis, Gladys join the clan; Taika stays.
171.name: Jason's Saint-Etienne spirit domain

172.content: Jason and Farrah build a giant Stonehenge-like ritual circle on a football field in an abandoned outback town to cross to Pallimustus on a warm autumn day (about month 49). Farrah goes to Switzerland first (via UN plane) to give essences to 'the most important person in the world' (a woman who moved there 25 years earlier; unnamed). Emi hugs Jason goodbye and stays. This sets up Jason's 'return' in Book 7 and the Earth lore for Book 11-13.
172.name: Jason leaves Earth (end of Book 6)

173.comment: Epilogue: Gary Gets His Groove Back (Pallimustus)
173.content: While Jason is on Earth: Gary (Gareth) quits adventuring after Jason's 'memorial' and becomes a blacksmith; Virid Martine (gold-rank smith, slender, handsome) tests and apprentices him (price: simple high-quality arms for remote villages); Gary reaches silver after more than a year with a core; he meets Jory, Belinda and Neil. His mother (leonid) calls him 'Gareth'. Rufus reached silver. Danielle Geller reached gold. The monster surge precursors have run over a year but the surge hasn't come.
173.name: Epilogue: Gary Gets His Groove Back (Pallimustus)

174.comment: Epilogue: Sophie, Humphrey, Neil and Emir (Kurdansk)
174.content: While Jason is away: Emir reveals Sophie was born in Kurdansk, People's Holy Federation of Dreisil. Humphrey, Sophie and Neil go undercover (oil wrestling) to find Marta Fries, a celestine who faked her friend Melody's death 20 years earlier. Callum Morse (gold, member of the Cult of the Reaper, works with the Church of Death) and Constance (now gold) intervene: the Order of the Reaper is an offshoot of the cult; Sky Scar Lake was a reconciliation faction sacrificed; Callum won't reveal Sophie's family trail until she reaches silver and the team is reunited. Knowledge tells Sophie to seek out Clive. The Gramid Passage (Pallimustus Mediterranean connecting Indian and Atlantic) and Rakesh (Magic Society campus, Continental Council) feature.
174.name: Epilogue: Sophie, Humphrey, Neil and Emir (Kurdansk)

175.content: Carlivexistrix 'Carli': milk-chocolate-skinned dragon (human form) companion of the Geller family, last child with the Gellers' diamond-rank ancestor; her toddler is Stash/Biscuit, Humphrey's bonded familiar (shapeshifting 'people talk'). Carli flies Humphrey and Sophie to find Clive and Belinda. Stash is a mirage dragon of Carli's line; Humphrey carries him as a hill mouse who says 'G'day, bloke'.
175.name: Carlivexistrix and Stash (Biscuit)

176.comment: Clive and Belinda escape Magic Society (Rakesh)
176.content: Clive is confined by the Magic Society in Rakesh (north coast; Continental Council and Magic Society campus; caste society) under Lady Prani Ajus and Vice-Dean Lorelei Grantham (who recruited him, sympathetic). He escapes via the Builder-cult/Purity portal network arch with Belinda's help (her Counterfeit Combatant), leaving notes. Later Lorelei joins the Magic Research Association as Vice Chancellor and travels with Jason's Earth expedition.
176.name: Clive and Belinda escape Magic Society (Rakesh)

177.content: Burning Violet: elite adventuring guild of the Remore family, headquartered in Vitesse across from Remore Academy (violet flame flower pins); chief membership officer Neiman Bassingthwaite (older gold, black face, white beard); factional strife over Remore control (Roland Remore, diamond). Team Biscuit's members were guild members; Jason's application in Book 12 ends with Roland alienating him and Team Biscuit withdrawing.
177.name: Burning Violet Guild

178.comment: Miles Cotezee and monster surge rules
178.content: Miles Cotezee: silver Adventure Society senior administrator (core-user; paper/knowledge/rune/scribe essences). When the surge is imminent the Adventure Society goes to 'monster surge rules': contracts become orders; Humphrey, Clive and Sophie are ordered to a remote village; Gary's village hosts Jory, Belinda, Neil, Rufus, Virid Martine and finally Dawn (diamond), who asks Gary to reforge Dread Salvation.
178.name: Miles Cotezee and monster surge rules

179.content: Jason silver status sheet (30% to gold): Power/Speed/Spirit/Recovery all Silver 3. Racials: Party Interface, Defiant, Spirit Domain, Tactical Map, Nirvanic Transfiguration, Dark Rider. Dark: Midnight Eyes S4, Cloak S4, Path S3, Hand S3, Shadow S3. Blood: Blood Harvest S3, Leech Bite S3, Feast of Blood S3, Sanguine Horror S3, Haemorrhage S3. Sin: Punish S3, Feast of Absolution S3, Sin Eater S3, Hegemony S4, Castigate S3. Doom: Inexorable Doom S3, Punition S3, Blade of Doom S3, Verdict S3, Avatar of Doom S3. Progress nearly stops: a wall at silver 4 requires essence revelations.
179.name: Jason's Silver Status (Book 6)

180.content: Elizabeth gives Jason a Blood Rebirth Crystal (gold conjured; revives a vampire at diminished power) as a trust pledge; it was actually Georges's crystal. Colin's aura frightens her ('something inside you more terrible than all of us'). She escapes the final battle.
180.name: Elizabeth, Blood Rebirth Crystal

181.comment: Book 7 - Summary (Rimaros, the surge, the Zara scandal, the One Day War)
181.content: BOOK 7: Jason and Farrah cross the world-link back to Pallimustus (his Spirit Realm 'travels' the link) and arrive in a tropical cyclone off the Storm Kingdom (Rimaros) as the monster surge, delayed ~15 years, begins. Dawn (full power) and Virid Martine meet the team; Gary and Virid reforge Dread Salvation into Hegemon's Will. Builder invasion platforms (floating cities, sea cities, fortresses) appear worldwide; the team captures a Builder ironclad skyship. Jason and Farrah register with the Rimaros Adventure Society (he must explain irregularities), reunite with Rufus (Gabrielle brings him), settle in Palisaros on Arnote. The royal family discovers Zara has publicly claimed Jason proposed to her to avoid a marriage to an Irios boy; Soramir and Liara 'take his measure'; Trenchant Moore tests him on supply runs. Jason fights bone feasters at Arcazitlan, ambushes by Purity silver trio, and discovers Melody Jain (Sophie's mother) leads a Purity enclave. His team destroys a Purity dam-valley ritual (119 Earth outworlders including Taika appear). The Builder cult aperture in Colombia is sealed with Jeni Kavaloa's expedition. Dawn brings Humphrey's team, Gary, Taika, Travis, Hurins and Arabelle to Rimaros. Team Biscuit is formally named. The Builder's rolling land city is melted by Dawn's phoenix; a Builder fortress-city over Livaros is destroyed by Travis's magitech device; Vesper, Ledev, Jeni and Warwick Warnock die. A month later Jason lets his friends into his spirit vault.
181.name: Book 7 - Summary (Rimaros, the surge, the Zara scandal, the One Day War)

182.content: Hegemon's Will (silver [growth], legendary sword; black blade, white ideographic sigils, bone handle, white-metal onyx hilt) reforged by Gary and Virid Martine in Zartos over 19 days: invoke a conjured weapon's effects into the blade: Ruin, the Blade of Tribulation (corrosive, Corrosion; red sigils) and Penitent, the Blade of Sacrifice (disruptive force; cleanses enemy holy afflictions and gives Hegemon's Mercy on the enemy and Benevolent Hegemon on the wielder; blue sigils). Hegemon's Dominion (scabbard, silver legendary): moves wielder's afflictions into the scabbard; sheathed, all transfer to the blade and hit the next enemy struck. Set bonus with the Amulet of the Dark Guardian: Hegemon's Authority per affliction. Growth no longer capped by rank.
182.name: Hegemon's Will and Hegemon's Dominion

183.content: Rimaros (Storm Kingdom): city of islands in the Sea of Storms (Caribbean analogue) ringed by storm accumulators (8-storey windmills on rocks, 20 km ring). Three natural islands: Livaros (adventurer island, Adventure Society campus, skyport, jobs hall), Arnote (westernmost, wealthy residential, quiet; Palisaros lagoon town with caramel-skinned celestines; Jason's house on the clifftop waterfall), Provo (east, non-magical populace, trade hub). Sky islands (held aloft by geysers) host the cream of society and the royal palace around a lake; water islands host merchants/low silvers. Culture: extreme specialisation and big teams (Vitesse prizes versatility). The Storm King must be a gold-ranker; heirs compete as adventurers; the Hurricane Princess is the firstborn daughter. Founder: Soramir Rimaros. Ruling House Rimaros (blue-haired). House Irios designs defences; Sapphire Crown is the royal guild. Emir Bahadir is banned (robbed the royals). Capital also hosts the Temple of Knowledge, Magic Society island and Temple of Death.
183.name: Rimaros / Storm Kingdom

184.content: Soramir Rimaros: male diamond-ranker, first king and founder of the Storm Kingdom (palindrome name 'Rimaros' reversed; palindromic names mark key family members), emerald hair in disguise; spends much time in the cosmos; strategically ruthless but affectionate to Zara; declared Jason 'the most important political relationship since the founding' (Zara). Dislikes ostentation. Zila Rimaros: female diamond-ranker royal ancestor (aunt Zila), emerald hair; ship 'Zila's Promise'. Both defend Rimaros against dragons and Builder constructs.
184.name: Soramir Rimaros and Zila Rimaros

185.comment: Zara and Jason - the Mourning Scandal
185.content: Zara Rimaros publicly claimed Jason proposed to her (gem berries/milk nut squares flirting) and entered a formal 2-year mourning after his 'death' to avoid a political marriage to a House Irios heir; Kasper Irios (peak bronze celestine, gunmetal hair; a year younger, gay) bailed, wanting a tattoo artist, who was exiled by airship with money. Jason (via Vesper and Liara) learns, tells Kasper to go home and talk to family. Jason calls it 'a story of war'. Liara and Vesper debate killing him; Soramir considers marrying him into the family; Jason resists ('I need to work on myself').
185.name: Zara and Jason - the Mourning Scandal

186.content: Trenchant Moore: gold-rank human swordsman (pale skin, jet-black hair, icy blue eyes), 'the Siege Sword', commander of the Sapphire Crown royal guard; family has served since Soramir founded the kingdom; survivor of Heartsilver Mountain (the Celestial Sword). Tests Jason on supply runs; assessed Jason as an affliction skirmisher ('run like the God of Pain was chasing me'). Later romantically involved with Farrah (hinted in Book 7, 'Trench... sweet' in Book 12).
186.name: Trenchant Moore

187.comment: Liara Rimaros, Vesper, Jeni Kavaloa and the royal family
187.content: Liara Rimaros: gold, remote royal branch, adventurer in Builder-response team, husband Baseph (House Amouz, underwater mine); runs/tests Jason ('worm on a hook'); survives. Vesper Rimaros: Zara's aunt/companion, silver, ~67, blue hair; dies in the Livaros battle. Jeni Kavaloa: gold, ice cloud/blades, expedition leader (dies at Livaros). Ledev and Jana: Liara's stealth teammates (Ledev dies carrying the device). Pelli: elderly gold core-user, royal blood, mayor of Palisaros. Estella Warnock: candy-pink-haired celestine spy/scout, granddaughter of Warwick Warnock (retired gold adventurer who dies at Livaros).
187.name: Liara Rimaros, Vesper, Jeni Kavaloa and the royal family

188.comment: Sapphire Crown / Irios / Magic Society in Rimaros
188.content: Sapphire Crown: guild of the royal family (non-royals serve in the royal guard; quarterly exams). House Irios: pre-eminent defensive engineering for cities/fortress towns; 'shield of the Storm Kingdom'; Irios founder was Soramir's 'brother'. Jacinda Irios wants to meet Jason. The Irios family contributed to the Livaros dome and defences.
188.name: Sapphire Crown / Irios / Magic Society in Rimaros

189.content: Builder invasion platforms appear worldwide during the surge via rainbow manifestations: sky fortress-cities, sea cities, a rolling land-city with thousands of thick legs, and a giant Kraken-construct underwater city (10 panels). Powered by diamond-rank constructs and abominations; staffed by converted cultists with clockwork cores. They are passive until the Builder moves; the Storm Kingdom and neighbours counter each in a concerted defence. The rolling city (with 2 diamond essence users and a diamond flesh-and-steel dragon abomination) destroyed two cities near the northern border before Dawn's phoenix melted it. Builder fortress-city over Livaros fell to Travis' device.
189.name: Builder Invasion Platforms

190.content: Dawn in Pallimustus: true celestine body with ruby hair/eyes; arrives in a flying cottage orb (snow globe) vessel; passed 'First Sister' to Helsveth and is now Hierophant (a title like a ruler); uses her single allowed intervention to melt the Builder's rolling land city with a cosmic phoenix ('I call back to the origin of infinity...'). Says Jason is a 'vase smashed and put back together'. She returned his sword.
190.name: Dawn - Hierophant and the Phoenix

191.content: When registering the team at the Adventure Society, Stash (as a puppy) blurts 'Biscuit' and the name 'Team Biscuit' is stamped. Members then: Jason, Humphrey, Sophie, Belinda, Clive, Neil, Farrah (guest/ally), later Zara; Rufus, Gary, Taika, Travis, Jory etc. are close allies. Team doctrine: versatility and worst-case planning rather than Rimaros-style specialisation.
191.name: Team Biscuit (named)

192.content: 119 humans from Earth (bronze/silver, heavy core users) appear naked and hairless in the craters of a destroyed Purity ritual valley; all ask for Jason Asano. Taika Williams (Māori; Aussie high-voice) is one of them and says he and Travis came through after the Earth rift expanded; Danielle Geller takes them to the Geller estate (later Cyrion). Taika knows the team from Jason's 'holiday videos'. In Book 12 about 74 of them return to Earth.
192.name: Taika and the 119 Outworlders

193.comment: Melody Jain and the Order of Redeeming Light
193.content: Melody Jain: dark-skinned, white-haired silver-ranker leader of an Order of Redeeming Light (Purity) enclave, Sophie's mother; faked her death 20 years earlier; Purity offers a Redeemed Core (lose powers, gain an entire rank, gold from silver; total faith required or become mindless). She wants Jason alive to lure her daughter. She is brainwashed by Purity/Builder magic and later treated by Carlos in Book 12. Marta Fries (celestine) was her friend. Second Sendira; priest Laront.
193.name: Melody Jain and the Order of Redeeming Light

194.content: Arcazitlan: cliff-carved gorge fortress town commanded by Mordant Kerr (Texan-drawl, 'never underestimate adventurers'), second Miranda 'Randy' Ramos, logistics Luis Garzón, sensor officer Adelina. Hundreds of silver bone feasters (faces are mouths; blind/deaf; grow bone armour and weapons) attack; Jason arrives on wings of darkness and handles them with dagger, Gordon's drilling beams, Colin and Feast of Absolution. Kerr gives him a letter for a Rimaros friend (Havi Estos).
194.name: Bone Feasters and Arcazitlan

195.content: Havi Estos: celestine (onyx skin, gold hair/eyes), former adventurer and Livaros crime boss; runs Warehouse District Three; gets Kerr's letter; Estella spied for her; assistant Jono (great-nephew). Told to 'give Warnock a name: Jason Asano'.
195.name: Havi Estos and Livaros underworld

196.comment: Gabrielle and Rufus in Rimaros; Death goddess
196.content: In Rimaros many people are identical celestine brothers all named Al (Alvin, Alexander, Alan, Albert, Alistair, Alfred, Alejandro 'the sexy one', Aldrich). Aldrich is a priest at the Temple of Death (garden array against necromancy; Jason must obtain identity certification; the Death goddess asks him to stop dying). Alejandro runs the tailor 'Sensual Attire for the Sensual Gentleman'. Gabrielle, priestess of Knowledge, escorts Rufus by portal; Knowledge could not see Jason's death/resurrection.
196.name: Gabrielle and Rufus in Rimaros; Death goddess

197.content: Early Book 7: Cloak of Night Silver 4 (03%), Hand of the Reaper S4 (silver Weakness of the Flesh, two arms connected), Hegemony S4, Feast of Absolution S4, Sin Eater S4, Punition S4, Verdict S4 (Sanction). Wall at silver 4: advancement slow ('If years of this is what it takes to reach gold...'). He cannot be revived until gold (his Nirvanic resurrection spent). Jason is 'almost aggressively unambitious' at the Fertility farm; 'I'm not your dog or worm on a hook'.
197.name: Jason's Silver status in Rimaros

198.comment: Skyships, Skyhunter Marlin, Bone Feasters etc. - monsters of Book 7
198.content: Monsters met: Skyhunter Marlin (flying dinosaur-fish), reef giant (gold, coral-embedded, 5 storeys), lobhoppers, storm shabs (shark-crab lightning), silver flying snake swarms, volcanic ant queen in a magma lake. Shade becomes a treasure beetle, a Tartarian beetle (bread-van size), an 8-legged panther, jet-ski, horses and a land skimmer.
198.name: Skyships, Skyhunter Marlin, Bone Feasters etc. - monsters of Book 7

199.comment: Fertility Church Farm Tower and Flor
199.content: The Temple of Fertility runs fortified farm towers (octagonal, dark green glass) for fortress towns, hydroponic alchemical gardens and coupling rooms; priestess Flor (bronze elf). Jason declines the coupling. The Church of Fertility distributes 'little man' pills; rivalry with the church of Lust.
199.name: Fertility Church Farm Tower and Flor

key: Of course he doesn't have pants
200.comment: Gold-rankers, Jason's Stage: Jason says goodbye to Earth
200.content: Jason's recording ('Of course he doesn't have pants') and farewell with Amy; the Stonehenge-like circle's stones turn to dark crystal as he leaves. Spirit Realm travels along the 'world link' (a rainbow stream of planetary scale) for weeks.
keys: Of course he doesn't have pants
200.name: Gold-rankers, Jason's Stage: Jason says goodbye to Earth

201.content: Estella Warnock: candy-pink-haired celestine silver, spy with four sensory powers, Warwick's granddaughter, defends Arnote; she moves into Warwick's house next to Jason's on Arnote after the war. Warwick Warnock: retired gold adventurer, tea drinker, helps Jason against an eel-tentacle sea monster; dies at Livaros.
201.name: Estella Warnock and Warwick Warnock

202.comment: Book 8 - Summary (Order of Redeeming Light, Reality Core portal, Astral Throne, Builder withdraws)
202.content: BOOK 8 (about a month after the One Day War; Rimaros/Sea of Storms): Team Biscuit and Rufus's group help sweep arid north-coast ruins and investigate a betrayed fortress town. Purity's Order of Redeeming Light (servitors with purified clockwork cores; leaders Melody Jain, Sendira, Fila, Ramona, Laront) hunts captive clockwork kings and raids a House Amouz underwater mining complex to kidnap Gibson Amouz (heir). Sophie learns her mother Melody leads the Order. Melody is captured by Jason and Sophie (Belinda has infiltrated the Order as 'Keth Gino' and sabotages the stronghold; Laront captured). To save ~20 trapped civilians Jason uses a Reality Core to force a portal through deep granite; the overload nearly kills him; his soul space becomes a vast black temple. The system shows his Fundament Gate and Firmament Bridge broken down into Fundament Core and Firmament Core, which become an ASTRAL THRONE and ASTRAL GATE; Jason is now an Astral King with an Astral Kingdom. Shako returns; Jason, Dawn, Builder and World-Phoenix negotiate: Builder pulls out of Pallimustus; Jason returns the Fundamental Realm Authority Token. Carlos reveals Purity's 'purification' is a modified lesser vampire curse and the god of Purity is probably Disguise or Deceit. Dawn leaves; Farrah and Travis leave adventuring to run a telecommunications business.
202.name: Book 8 - Summary (Order of Redeeming Light, Reality Core portal, Astral Throne, Builder withdraws)

203.content: Purity's Order of Redeeming Light: cellular zealot order whose members undergo 'flames of redemption' (lose imagination) and may be implanted with purified clockwork cores from a clockwork king (lose essence abilities, gain a rank, obey absolutely; two gold converted per party are trump cards). Leaders: Melody Jain (local leader; born celestine, now white-haired; Way of the Reaper infiltrator), Sendira (raid commander), Fila (air scout), Ramona (earth, former celestine), Marika, Elise, Caitlyn, Heston (cell leaders), Kelleigh (low-silver fixer), Rhett and Jaime (comic ex-amphora duo with a beverage hat), priest Laront (human, silver; brother Killian Laurent). Targets: isolated fortress towns (massacred and disguised as monsters), clockwork kings, Gibson Amouz. Carlos: the 'purification' is a modified lesser vampire curse.
203.name: Order of Redeeming Light

204.content: Melody Jain: Sophie's mother, born celestine, now dark-skinned white-haired silver (near gold), trained in the Way of the Reaper 'before you were born', leader of the local Order of Redeeming Light. Faked her death ~20 years earlier with Marta Fries; held a daughter-based lure for Jason. After capture in the flooded Amouz complex she is hooded, held in the Asano pagoda; treated for brainwashing by Carlos in Book 12 (success). Her disguise inside Purity is 'Order of the Reaper Infiltrator (sealed)'. Sophie punches her.
204.name: Melody Jain

205.comment: House Amouz and the underwater mining complex
205.content: House Amouz controls more than half of Sea of Storms mining. Lord Cassin Amouz (gold celestine, goatee, ex-adventurer). Gibson 'Gibbie' Amouz is the heir captured by the Order. Baseph Rimaros (Liara's husband, upper-silver administrator and first-time killer) floods the underwater mining complex as a last defence. Liara's children: Dara (37, one-star frontliner), Zareen (three-star, politically savvy, close to Vesper), Joseph (administrator). Casallini is a border city of cartel-ruled Girlano used by Purity cut-outs to ambush Sophie.
205.name: House Amouz and the underwater mining complex

206.comment: Reality Core portal and the black Temple
206.content: To save ~20 trapped civilians in the flooded Amouz complex, Jason forces a portal using a Reality Core as power source (archway turns black marble with a blue/orange nebula void); Jason's soul over-charges with silver-blue mana; Clive burns himself with Eldritch Imbalance and vents via Wrath of the Magister; Shade bodies detonate as mana sinks; Gordon amputates limbs and Colin regrows them; Neil's Hero's Moment and Bolster stabilise him. Afterwards the cloud house is a black evil-looking temple; only friends enter; others' auras are suppressed and flesh rots (a god-like aura). Jason is unconscious days; he 'never intended to succeed' in founding a temple but Dominion is interested.
206.name: Reality Core portal and the black Temple

207.comment: Astral Throne, Astral Gate and Soul Forge
207.content: After the reality-core event, Fundament Gate and Firmament Bridge break down into Fundament Core, Fundamental Realm Authority Token, Firmament Core and Firmamental Bridge Anchor; Jason's spirit realm consumed the cores to establish the ASTRAL THRONE (internal functions; his throne room has a wicker hammock chair) and ASTRAL GATE (interaction with outside dimensional forces; enhances abilities at backlash risk; a sea-cave geyser of raw magic and a glass tunnel under the sea). A third element, the SOUL FORGE (soul engineering), follows (Jason acquires it in Book 11 reintegration). Jason becomes an Astral King: a sentient miniature universe ('You are your domain'). The astral kingdom: island ~30x15 km with a mountain, beaches, lagoon town and a central city with a 10-storey pagoda. Astral kings rule through messengers (whose message is 'Kneel'); Jason's familiars become eternal/avatar bonded.
207.name: Astral Throne, Astral Gate and Soul Forge

208.comment: Fundamental Realm Authority Token and Authority
208.content: Authority = the fundamental power of great astral beings (their flesh, blood and soul; gods embody a singular concept). Two states: set-state (put to a purpose, like a clay bowl or spirit domain) and potential-state (raw, like enriched uranium). Transformation zones are set-state authority breaking down to potential-state; domes are scabs; ulcers are open wounds. The Fundamental Realm Authority Token (transcendent; bound to Jason and Zithis Carrow Vayel; opens gates to the fundamental realm of any physical reality) is returned to the Builder in the Book 8 deal. Cloud Flask becomes an authority artefact with a max potential rank of Transcendent; Reality Hegemon title expanded.
208.name: Fundamental Realm Authority Token and Authority

209.content: Jason convenes a triangle in his pagoda: the Builder (via Shako) and World-Phoenix (via Dawn) manifest. Jason obtains (1) the Builder will open the way to the fundamental realm once, when needed, and (2) the Builder's forces leave Pallimustus today (Jason threatens to feed authority to his familiars as 'performance bonus'). The World-Phoenix, angered by an addendum, drives the Builder berserk; Shako goes catatonic. Carmen of the Sundered Throne (cloak with mountain-nebula, 12 orbs, from the region of the All-Devouring Eye next to Legion's realm) collects Shako. Dawn is now a free Hierophant; she tells the team (not Jason, Clive) to reach gold in 10-20 years and to follow her instructions exactly when she returns.
209.name: Builder, World-Phoenix and Jason's negotiation (Book 8)

210.comment: Carlos' revelation on Purity and the Order
210.content: Carlos Quilido and Arabelle conclude the Order's 'purification' is a modified lesser vampire curse (a taint working on anything with magic; converts cannot genuinely worship). The god of Purity is not truly Purity: likely a deception god (Deceit or Disguise) disguised as Purity; gods cannot reveal it (interplay rules). Gods probably sanctioned Purity long ago; the Ecumenical Council has found escalating impropriety for decades. Knowledge secretly raised forces. Jason later learns Disguise gave up pretending to be Purity (world chaos). Jason rages at Carlos ('LOOK AT WHAT I AM!').
210.name: Carlos' revelation on Purity and the Order

211.comment: Estella Warnock, Vidal Ladiv and Odds-and-ends
211.content: Vidal Ladiv: bronze-then-silver Adventure Society official, Rimaros Civic Authority Council liaison; Miguel Ladiv is his relative (later Jason's Adventure Society liaison in Book 12). Office of Organised Enemy Response (head Ramon Keel) replaces the Builder-response unit. Team Work Saw: elite generalist Rimaros team (leonid defender Henry Xeller, an elf all-flavour mage, a growing-arrow archer, two brawlers and a healer-leader named Carlos). Rosalie Peresda: guild leader of area-attackers with a flying carpet; healer Paola.
211.name: Estella Warnock, Vidal Ladiv and Odds-and-ends

212.content: Dawn stays in the pagoda while Jason recovers, a hug improves his recovery, and she teaches him a 'dual cultivation' aura exchange; the intimacy is implied. Dawn punches him (hurts her), warns him to avoid a hidden danger, says he stopped aging since the World-Phoenix blessing and that Jason, Sophie and Rufus have the 'X factor' for diamond; Gary and Travis are craftsman paths. Final farewell on the balcony: she flies up as a flare. Dawn's parents rule a small intergalactic empire (she is a 'magic space princess').
212.name: Dawn - leaving Pallimustus (Book 8 end)

213.comment: Jason's Cloud Flask / Pagoda on Arnote
213.content: After authority infuses the Cloud Flask, Jason's cloud house on Arnote becomes a five-storey dark-crystal pagoda (tallest on the island) with an atrium waterfall pool, tropical plants and a fireman's pole. Melody Jain is held in a pagoda room. Dominion visits, Disguise stops pretending to be Purity.
213.name: Jason's Cloud Flask / Pagoda on Arnote

214.content: Farrah Hurin and Travis Noble start a telecommunications company: a magic phone network with static connection points over relay towers, piloted in the Sea of Storms with fortress-town towers, backed by Rimaros's civic government (this becomes the Sky Link Company; competes with the Magic Society's water link). Knowledge/Gabrielle controls what Travis introduces. Farrah will not return to adventuring; Rufus stays until Greenstone to teach; Gary is a full-time smith.
214.name: Farrah and Travis' telecommunications business

215.comment: Belinda Callahan infiltrates the Order (Keth Gino)
215.content: Belinda shape-shifts into Keth Gino, a wandering drone-like Order member, to enter the Order's mountain stronghold, sabotages submarines and doors with chalk sigils, a Rune Trap and bombs, finds Gibson Amouz, and captures Laront (the Order's priest, found chained in a kink-like game). Trenchant blows open the mountain side. Liara's trade: delivering Laront stops the pressure about Sophie's mother.
215.name: Belinda Callahan infiltrates the Order (Keth Gino)

216.comment: Callum Morse, Order of the Reaper and Sophie's mother
216.content: Callum Morse, ex-teammate of Emir, Gabriel and Arabelle, tells Sophie he knows where her mother is; Jason refuses him entry; Callum goes to Arabelle (Temple of the Healer) who warns him. He investigates the Order of the Reaper. Sophie is angry that Emir and Callum used her as bait.
216.name: Callum Morse, Order of the Reaper and Sophie's mother

217.content: Sophie's gift Celestial Swiftness evolves to Princess of the Firmament; Way of the Wind (special ability affinity); powers: Leaf on the Wind, Free Runner, Avatar of Speed, Child of the Celestial Wind. Celestines have special ability affinity + astral affinity and are the best portal users. Sophie and Humphrey are together; she chose Humphrey before Jason's return. She rampages in Casallini after the ambush.
217.name: Sophie and Humphrey (Book 8)

218.comment: Gibson Amouz and the forge factory
218.content: Underground chamber with two intact clockwork kings (white lacquer and brass skeletal four-armed), a third dismantled, controlled by Sendira's device; gold portal user Esteban Galo (hired through Killian) portals the kings out. Melody's real target was Gibson Amouz, heir of House Amouz, to fund a construct factory.
218.name: Gibson Amouz and the forge factory

219.content: Book 8 silver abilities: Clive - Instant Karma, Mantle of Retribution, Juxtapose (S1), Blood Magic (Balance S4), Eldritch Imbalance (S3); Neil - Burst Shield S2, Grand Renewal S2, Verdant Cage S1, Chrysalis Golem; Humphrey - Hero's Sacrifice, Shield Breaker, Relentless Assault, Unstoppable Force, Razor Wing Sword; Belinda - Instant Adept, Force Tether, Lightning Tether, Pit of the Reaper, Bag of Tricks, Counterfeit Combatant, Mirror Magic; Sophie - Between the Raindrops, Mirage Step, Eternal Moment, Wind Blade, Immortal Fist, Radiant Fist.
219.name: Instant Karma / Team abilities silver

220.comment: Book 9 - Summary (John Miller, Yaresh and the messengers)
220.content: BOOK 9: After the Builder's withdrawal, Rimaros celebrates; Jason's team adopts a second identity: Jason Asano 'leaves with Soramir' while 'John Miller', a silver auxiliary cook, travels with Team Biscuit. Killian Laurent is caught (Havi Estos's tip, Liara's forces); Jason and Hector de Varco fight duels at the royal ball and arena; gold intruders wreck his pagoda; the team departs south by cloud yacht with Carlos's crime wagon, Callum, Arabelle, Amos and Orin Pensinata and Korinne's Team Storm Shredder. They deliver supplies in ruined Cartise (a city torn when the Builder cult stole an astral space), then reach Yaresh, an elf rainforest city threatened by messengers (angelic gestalt beings of astral kings) and a natural array underground. Jason cooks as John Miller, fights in the cage dens (Sophie is the Nightingale champion), meets the valash outworlder Zolit Kreen, the messenger voices Jes Fin Kaal and Fal Vin Garath, kills Pei Vas Kartha (world-taker worm breeder) and frees prisoners. Haliastur the Garuda and Taika (now silver) help against a naga genesis egg. The Battle of Yaresh: Jason projects his soul across the city (Gordon's orrery ritual), Raythe kills diamond messenger Mah Go Schaat, Jason frees Tera Jun Casta from her astral king's mark and Marek Nior Vargas defects with his people to Jason's astral realm. Messengers exist as controlled silver-capped batteries of astral kings.
220.name: Book 9 - Summary (John Miller, Yaresh and the messengers)

221.comment: John Miller (Jason's alias) and the one-star badge
221.content: To stay hidden, Jason keeps a second identity 'John Miller', a silver-rank cook-auxiliary with a one-star Adventure Society badge (star in a circle; cannot take solo missions) while his real three-star identity draws stars as idiosyncratic pentagrams. Vidal Ladiv hands him the paperwork. Jason Asano is said to have left with Soramir; a Shade body stays at the palace as decoy. Team joke: Captain Handsome Boatman, Buck Stone etc. Jason also uses 'Neil Davone' and other aliases in the past.
221.name: John Miller (Jason's alias) and the one-star badge

222.content: Havi Estos tips Jason that Killian Laurent is in Jaitari (largest city of the Storm Kingdom, central island); Killian kidnaps Havi to bait Jason; Jason had secretly called Liara and Sapphire Crown/Amouz gold-rankers; Killian is chained under a layered ritual array and gives the name Esteban Galo (gold portal user). Cassin Amouz thanks Belinda ('door of House Amouz always open').
222.name: Killian Laurent captured

223.content: At the palace ball, House de Varco (vehicle makers of Rajoras) challenge Jason's group: Lancet de Varco is withdrawn at the King's request, Hector de Varco (stone-transformation, mimicloth) accepts a four-vs-four set of duels in the old arena under the sky-island lake. Results: Sophie beats Mistress Draglund (Fog of Swords) with Moment of Oneness; Rufus beats Glenn Twenhey with a plain scimitar (counts coup); Humphrey (Immortality) beats the Smoke Hunter; Jason soul-attacks Hector until Soramir stops it. Prize: de Varco vehicle design matrices and materials, which become Jason's cloud yacht (third hybrid mode). Lady Astasia de Varco is gold. Jason: 'I am a republican.'
223.name: The Royal Ball and Duels (Rimaros)

224.comment: Jason's yacht and Team Storm Shredder
224.content: Jason's new vessel: a superyacht-sized cloud hovercraft with a bridge piloted by Shade, an owner's cabin and privacy screens (part of his spirit domain; even gods can't see inside). A convoy: Jason's yacht, Carlos's 'Crime Wagon' (prison/hospital/lodging), Callum+Arabelle's skimmer van and Korinne's Outpost Rover. Team Storm Shredder: Korinne Pescos (leader), Kalif (electric chain arrows), Orin Pensinata (silver, Amos's nephew), Rosa Liselos (scout), Polix. Amos Pensinata (gold, might/vast/deep/leviathan; soul-trauma aura like Jason's) trains Jason's aura control (shape rain into ritual circles). Zara (now Zara Nareen, teal hair) joins Korinne's team.
224.name: Jason's yacht and Team Storm Shredder

key: There's always work to be done
225.content: Amos Pensinata: gold-rank adventurer (might, vast, deep, leviathan; ocean monsters), gravel voice ('There's always work to be done'); soul-damaged with a Jason-like aura; Carlos met him in a lunatic's dungeon; a favour from Dawn makes him Jason's aura-control mentor if Jason takes nephew Orin. In the Battle of Yaresh he leads a defence. His Greater Miracle Potion cured a burned adventurer.
keys: There's always work to be done
225.name: Amos Pensinata

226.content: Arabelle reveals Callum Morse loves Melody Jain and was her handler ~25 years. Melody (from an old Order of the Reaper family from Kurdansk) secretly married and had Sophie (Jain) with help from the Church of Fertility; Marta Fries smuggled husband and child away; the Cult of the Reaper ordered Melody to infiltrate Purity's Order of Redeeming Light, where she was 'purified' and lost contact. Sophie was found in a shipwreck near Greenstone, perhaps memory-altered; her father is unknown. Emir's patron (a diamond historian friendly to the cult) had him collect Way of the Reaper books to find her father.
226.name: Melody's backstory and Callum Morse

227.content: Cartise: river city destroyed when the Builder cult tore out an astral space and a diamond monster struck; ruins like post-Blitz London; a polished marble-smooth crater; refugees; the lingering magical resonance draws monsters (the Adventure Society wants this to protect refugee towns). Adventure Society guide Vestine Calhoun. Glorious Harvester butterflies (rare swarm monsters) dissolve monster bodies. Rajoras: large southern coastal city on the Rajo estuary, seat of House de Varco. Arc lightning lizards (cobalt iguanas with chain lightning) are the weakest silvers.
227.name: Cartise

228.content: Yaresh: elf rainforest city of tens of thousands (glossy black stone walls between giant trees; elves from almond to milk-chocolate skin) on a war footing, with the Church of Knowledge, War's camps and messenger strongholds around and a natural array underground. Underworld: Urman Vohl (entertainment-district boss), sons Valk and Emresh (silver core user who shakes down Bellory). Jason works as cook 'John Miller' at Bellory's pub. Underground fight dens run by Zolit Kreen. Two native diamond elf adventurers, Allayeth and Charist, rule the area.
228.name: Yaresh

229.content: Zolit Kreen: valash outworlder (skinny, chihuahua-like heads; Earth humans turned valash by transformation zones), silver fight organiser in a white 80s Miami suit, controlled by his elf aide Benella ('Bennie', ex-adventurer whose team was annihilated; later adopted by Kaal). Zolit is a messenger project: the astral king Vesta Carmis Zell wrapped a NAGA GENESIS EGG (apocalypse beast turning flesh into naga) in his outworlder soul. Argrave Mericulato, a bitter silver functionary, uses a needle to shrink Zolit into the egg orb.
229.name: Zolit Kreen and Benella

230.content: Messengers: gestalt beings (body and soul fused; tall ~1.5x celestine height; wings; alabaster skin, solid gold eyes; no nipples) native to other realities, who believe themselves the highest life of the cosmos; they are the servants of astral kings, whose message is 'Kneel', capped at silver (a seal siphons their potential into the astral king; Voices of the Will can reach gold, diamond messengers may become astral kings). Their bodies/souls give superior aura magic; they use isolation (duel) powers, aura masks, world-taker worms and apocalypse beasts. The Unorthodoxy is dissenting messengers (Marek Nior Vargas) who want to live without astral kings. Resurrection doesn't work on messengers. They are 'budded' like plants (Book 12).
230.name: Messengers (Pallimustus)

231.comment: Jes Fin Kaal, Fal Vin Garath and Hess Jor Nasala
231.content: Yaresh messengers: Jes Fin Kaal (gold, ritualist Voice of the Will, red robe, white wings, serving a female astral king, Vesta Carmis Zell; plots a trap to get Mah Go Schaat killed); Fal Vin Garath (silver, ~8 ft, tests Jason, mouth stripped then restored by Kaal); Hess Jor Nasala (silver, dark skin, silver hair, black-and-white wings); Mah Go Schaat (diamond messenger with brown wings, killed by Raythe); Pei Vas Kartha (lowest-caste silver worm breeder, killed by Jason's Verdict/Colin); Tera Jun Casta (18, 7ft+, pixie cut; duel power; Jason frees her from her astral king's mark); Marek Nior Vargas (gold commander of the breach force, apolitical realist, defects with friend Payan Nior Roel and his people to Jason's astral realm).
231.name: Jes Fin Kaal, Fal Vin Garath and Hess Jor Nasala

232.content: World-taker worms: brown forearm-long chitin-drill-cap parasites classed as apocalypse beasts; take over host bodies and absorb life magic; hosts look alive. Heat-consuming hive-mind; cold is good against them; messengers carry orbs that repel them; elite worms in silver hosts have independent minds. Hidden under a slate-brick workshop: breeding vats, a bloated brood queen and four colour-coded special worms for higher hosts. Colin devours the matriarch and can become a Voice of the Will after hibernation. Carlos finds a way to extract worms if caught early.
232.name: World-taker worms

233.content: Haliastur: giant (8+ ft) golden-haired hawk-nosed man with a gourd of amrita and an umbrella, the Garuda (non-essence transcendent presence ~Dawn level), who has chased the naga genesis egg for two decades; knows Shade; mentions Interstice to be introduced after diamond; calls Dawn 'Little Dawnie'.
