He lets the egg grow and fights a giant diamond-rank hydra of snake heads in garuda form (eagle head, four arms, golden wings, emerald skin).
233.name: Haliastur the Garuda

234.content: Taika ranks to silver during the Battle of Yaresh. Garuda confluence (might, swift, bird, wing): Emerald Flesh/Skin, King of the Sky (garuda shape: eagle head, red/gold feathers, talons), Grace of Garuda, Golden Wings, Block Out the Sun, Feaster of Serpents, Amrita, Brother of the Dawn, God-Striking Fist (extreme cost, 666-min cooldown, transcendent at silver), Momentous Charge, Unstoppable Strike, Unbowed aura (Courage boon). Meditation 'Golden Wings Transcending the Heavens'. Beats Fal Vin Garath inside Jason's pyramid bunker. Wants to return to his family on Earth.
234.name: Taika Williams - Garuda powers

235.content: Raythe: elf, half-transcendent maximal diamond (amber glowing eyes, light-brown hair with green flecks) who 'serves the Sand' (Keeper of Sands/Moments); accelerates time streams; stops Mah Go Schaat from rushing Jason ('Leave or die... I have time') and kills him, placing the corpse at Jason's feet. Jason drains it with Blood Harvest, gaining a star phoenix availability.
235.name: Raythe

236.comment: Gordon's orrery ritual and intrinsic-mandate magic
236.content: In the Battle of Yaresh Gordon unseals an orrery ritual (intrinsic-mandate magic): a glowing 3D magical orrery that projects Jason's whole soul as a declaration across the entire city, using the Astral Gate (Dawn warned him not to; earlier tapping cost months of convalescence). Messengers' harmonic aura link breaks; about half the silver messengers go berserk or catatonic. Astral kings' magic is intrinsic mandate (their will is law within their domain).
236.name: Gordon's orrery ritual and intrinsic-mandate magic

237.comment: Jason frees Tera Jun Casta; the astral king mark
237.content: Inside Tera's soul Jason finds (1) a mark ('soul-shaper'; astral king's brand), (2) a sealed potential (messengers capped at silver; Voices' 'raised limits' adjust the seal), (3) the duel power's mechanism (kills both after minutes if neither dies). Jason's own mark translates as 'hegemon' (the language of his sword and Mark of Sin). He overwrites the brand with his own, ends the duel and pops the seal. Vesta Carmis Zell (astral king; soul engineer who watches servant races battle and resurrects them) feels her seal vanish and calls the Council of Kings; her golem servant Hallas is a living soul in a 7-ft white-and-gold body.
237.name: Jason frees Tera Jun Casta; the astral king mark

238.comment: Marek's briefing on the natural array
238.content: Marek explains the astral king (Vesta Carmis Zell) seeks something buried under Yaresh (why the naga egg was placed there): the natural array, a subterranean city of Smoulder (earth/fire sub-species with centuries of exposure), plus a Builder-cult-occupied astral space below; a three-way war involves Knowledge's army and Adventure Society camps. The array imbues elemental magic and makes messengers mutate with devolving intelligence; essence users and Builder converts resist, so messengers enslave essence users to dig. Kaal wants Jason (an astral king) to lead an essence-user force to retrieve it.
238.name: Marek's briefing on the natural array

239.comment: Mercy speech and Jason's moral line
239.content: Jason kills Pei Vas Kartha by faith-crushing argument, Verdict and Blood Harvest (star phoenix readiness 0.3%), then nearly tears a cultist's body off his soul (Book 7) and uses a facsimile of the Builder's soul-scouring pain on Tera (which he swore never to use). His father's advice: when someone is at your mercy, it is a chance to decide who you are. 'If no one dares to be a fool, all there will be is darkness.' Shade is his conscience.
239.name: Mercy speech and Jason's moral line

240.comment: Healer visits; Purity's creation; Genesis Command: Life
240.content: The Healer (brown robes, grey beard) visits Jason in the cloud hospital: Dominion is 'my boy'; sanctioning is an extreme change in a transcendent's nature (the old Builder still exists beneath); Purity sanctioned himself by expending all his authority into an act of creation (an artefact that can purge monster-core effects) that inspired the messenger invasion. The gods unilaterally decree none will interfere in the search; only a new Purity may. Healer gives Jason [Genesis Command: Life] (transcendent legendary, 1 use): gives true life to an astral construct from a dimensional space (bound to that space).
240.name: Healer visits; Purity's creation; Genesis Command: Life

241.comment: Hana Shavar and the Healer's church in Yaresh
241.content: Hana Shavar: gold High Priestess of the Church of the Healer in Yaresh (green eyes, light brown hair), runs the refugee camp in Jason's cloud hospital. Eilaf Hayel: gold elf commander of the entertainment-district defence. Fiora Luth: silver Adventure Society logistics admin. Elseth Culie: elf affliction specialist rescued by Jason's Feed me your sins.
241.name: Hana Shavar and the Healer's church in Yaresh

242.comment: Gary leads the craftspeople; Zara's Storm Shredder fights
242.content: During the Battle of Yaresh Gary (leonid, almost gold-rank strength; hammer, iron, fire, forge essences; ten-foot six-ton Forge Golem) leads a craftspeople rescue group and defeats a silver summoner messenger; Zara and Team Storm Shredder fight messengers. Rufus's Eclipse zone kills messengers. Onslow's humanoid vessel is speared and his spirit returns later.
242.name: Gary leads the craftspeople; Zara's Storm Shredder fights

243.comment: Clive's Magister's Ballista and Mana Tide
243.content: Clive uses Mana Tide (Balance; 4-hr cooldown; escalating recovery), Wrath of the Magister variants (Prismatic Affliction/Void, Spell & Weapon Enhancement Ritual), Mana Shield, Blood Magic, Vengeance Mirror, Rune Traps, and secretly draws a ritual circle to trigger Magister's Ballista (force spear) killing a messenger. His wand Magister's Tithe was lost; staff Spell Lance of the Magister remains.
243.name: Clive's Magister's Ballista and Mana Tide

244.comment: Jason vs Tera in the bunker; Emresh Vohl
244.content: Jason (in heart-print boxers) fights Tera Jun Casta in an isolation sphere, then through a breach into the entertainment-district bunker warehouse. His astral realm/soul can't be suppressed by her soul-shell. Emresh Vohl hiding as a civilian recognises 'the tavern man'. Jason overwrites her mark and she remains unconscious weeks after.
244.name: Jason vs Tera in the bunker; Emresh Vohl

245.comment: Book 9 aftermath: Marek's people, Cloud flask maker, Rick's team
245.content: Weeks after the battle: city rebuilding; Jason hides in his soul space dodging diamond-rankers (who broke into his cloud palace; Hana filed complaints). The cloud flask's maker, a nondescript gender-shifting diamond-ranker woman, waits outside; her override device can return Emir's palace to its flask but not Jason's. Marek's people accept Jason as an astral king: he swaps their astral-king marks for their own marks (Pios Val Haat refuses and dies). Rick Geller's team (Hannah, Claire, Phoebe, Dustin Kettering) arrives as 'translators'; Allayeth and Charist (diamond elf adventurers) are frustrated; Soramir says force is a bad idea.
245.name: Book 9 aftermath: Marek's people, Cloud flask maker, Rick's team

246.content: Emir Bahadir (with Constance, now gold and his wife) is hired by diamond-rank clients to find the artefact that cleanses monster-core effects (Purity's creation), as one of many middlemen; adventurers aren't told the target. Messengers seek a monopoly on turning core users into non-core users. Humphrey decides Team Biscuit will participate but not hand it over blindly.
246.name: Emir's treasure hunt at Yaresh

247.content: Jason builds a dark jungle greenhouse (black red-sheen brick, pit of blood) as Colin's biomass storehouse; Colin and Gordon accepted a crude permanent bond via the astral throne/gate while Jason was unconscious (astral kings bestow powers through bonds). Colin can become a Voice of the Will after hibernation in the astral kingdom. Jason promises Gordon an upgrade; Shade isn't linked the same way.
247.name: Jason's soul-space upgrades (Book 9)

248.content: Jason's abilities silver 4: Verdict (S4, transcendent, Sanction), Blood Harvest (can move toward star phoenix state readiness by absorbing diamond corpses), Feast of Absolution (revokes afflictions leaving transcendent damage on messengers), Sin Eater raises maxima. His eyes have nebula irises and void-black sclera; Belinda gives him a pair of blue coins (appearance device restoring dark brown human eyes). Jason's hood shows a head silhouette; his cloak looks like a portal.
248.name: Jason's Silver 4 and abilities list (Book 9)

249.comment: Book 10 - Summary (Cardinas, the Death Pact, Undeath, Gary the Demigod)
249.content: BOOK 10 (Yaresh region, Pallimustus; autumn-winter after Book 9): In the aftermath of Yaresh, Jason hides messenger defectors (Marek, Tera, Jali) in his astral realm, bargains with Allayeth (diamond) and Charist, shames the Aristocratic Faction with Continental Council envoy Marcus Hargrave Xenoria, and recruits the Church of Liberty. Jason gets Colin hatched as his Voice of the Will. Kaal hands over a messenger device (a dimensional differentiator to forge a soul forge) and Jason leads a silver/gold expedition (Team Biscuit, Rick Geller's team, Korinne's team, Team Moon's Edge, Emir, Gabriel, Arabelle, Amos, Carlos, Hana) down the shaft into the natural array: elemental messengers, spider moles, the Cult of the Builder (Beaufort), the brightheart Smoulder city Cardinas (Citadel of Pillars; Lorenn, Marla) and the corrupted Birthing Tree. Destruction and the Church of Undeath (Garth Larosse, Jameela, Jeff) turn ~200,000 dead into undead. Jason prays to the goddess of Death and makes the Death Pact: he can never resurrect himself or others; title Keeper of the Cycle; Divine Ghost Fire. Boris Ket Lundi (an Earth-born Unorthodox messenger) joins. Gary drinks the Cup of Heroes to become a demigod and holds the wall. The tree and shaft are prepared for a transformation zone, ending with Jason's ritual starting the zone. Appendix lists Jason's silver abilities.
249.name: Book 10 - Summary (Cardinas, the Death Pact, Undeath, Gary the Demigod)

250.comment: Death Pact and Keeper of the Cycle
250.content: In the Cardinas death chamber Jason prays and meets the goddess of Death (a stocky middle-aged woman in a colourful dress in this region; 'Death knows how to wait'). She refuses his banked resurrections as sacrifice and offers a pact: Jason may never resurrect himself or anyone else (he may stasis the dying until another resurrects). In return: title Keeper of the Cycle; undeath energy is excluded from his soul realm, spirit domains and aura; divine power given to undead is negated; afflictions also apply Ghost Fire (harmless to living, calms and shields from undeath; transcendent DoT on undead); allies in his aura gain ghost fire. Death's miracle is Divine Ghost Fire on all defenders (white ethereal flames; may not resurrect while under it; spreads to undead) and resetting Undeath's claimed territory once. Jason hands over his stored messenger life-force. He no longer resurrects (star phoenix state flagged).
250.name: Death Pact and Keeper of the Cycle

251.comment: Church of Undeath and Garth Larosse
251.content: God Undeath (a living man in black robes with crimson-spark eyes and gravel voice) is the corruption of the cycle itself; his church is reviled. In Cardinas his priests turn ~200,000 dead brighthearts and messengers into undead (spawning pits, 'boomer' exploding mounds, grave and pyre elementals). High Priest Garth Larosse (9 ft lich-like skeleton from a dozen monsters, green cloak, red-eyed skull, 'Skeletor'/chuuni) leads dozens of gold/silver priests; Priestess Jameela (tall, beautiful ex-adventurer); silver Priest Jeff (comic relief; grandmother a high priestess of Destruction). They try to build an avatar of Undeath (giant zombie) from the best corpse parts using the messenger tree as base. Undeath says 'the enemy has one with the power. Jason Asano; kill him if you can.' Later (Book 11) Garth is killed via an incompatible messenger heart. Destruction 'gleefully stepped back to watch'.
251.name: Church of Undeath and Garth Larosse

252.content: Cardinas: underground Smoulder city ruled from the Citadel of Pillars, a dimensional prefabrication of clashing architecture, population under 10,000 survivors (less than 1/20). Brightheart Smoulder have obsidian skin with glowing affinity markings (fire, ash, magma, metal). Last council member Lorenn (ash aspect); guide Marla (metal, red-orange glow, gay); Hilda (young magma silver); Kollas (metal-shaper defender). Their ancestors came by a long tunnel from the west; they were peaceful and elementals were placid. The natural array's wellspring: three balancing essences at its heart (plant, life, water). The Builder cult (led by Beaufort, an elf-disguised 15 ft girder-skeleton war form) invaded to take Cardinas's uniquely solid astral space; messengers punched in and left a Birthing Tree. Jason evacuates ~10,000 brighthearts into his soul realm (they later found Rexion/Outer Rexion).
252.name: Cardinas and the Brighthearts

253.comment: Birthing Tree and Soul Forge attempt
253.content: The messengers' device is a dimensional differentiator that isolates elemental layers of the natural array to create a neutral matrix (a soul forge, every astral king having one except Jason). The Birthing Tree in the natural array chamber (leafless pillar-volcano, lava sap) is the corrupted result of a failed attempt to create a soul forge; its roots consume organic matter and spawn elemental messengers; its will is young, scared and erratic, not malevolent. Jason resolves to heal it; later the tree person becomes Arbour/Voice of the Will in Jason's soul (Book 11).
253.name: Birthing Tree and Soul Forge attempt

254.content: Beaufort: gold-ranker head of the Builder-cult forces in Cardinas; elf body is a disguise, true war form a 15 ft girder skeleton of dark iron with four arms, harpoon trident and ceramic axe; star seed gives internal dimensional storage; no essences. Calls Jason 'the Defier'. The Builder urged him to bet on Jason's mercy. They ally in Book 10.
254.name: Beaufort (Builder cult gold-ranker)

255.content: Allayeth: diamond elf (green eyes, light-brown skin, wavy wood-brown hair), last of her family; subtle diplomat; mentor of Team Moon's Edge; childhood trauma (fleeing a burning home); enters Jason's soul realm and learns the power is Jason himself; asks him to call her 'Ally'; fears 'a planet won't hold you'; killed all messenger servants with thorns in Ch45 ('Some things can't be forgiven'). Charist: blunt, confrontational diamond elf of Yaresh; breaks into Jason's palace; flings elemental messengers at the moon with an air vortex. Both settled in Yaresh and limit themselves to the region.
255.name: Allayeth and Charist

256.comment: Team Moon's Edge and Miriam Vance
256.content: Team Moon's Edge: six all-woman gold-rank team mentored by Allayeth; tactical commander Miriam Vance; Valetta (floats in silver light, architect, watches rather than rescues researchers to test Jason, later given a second chance); Alice (berserker 'zone of annihilation'). Miriam questions Jason and works the death-chamber defence.
256.name: Team Moon's Edge and Miriam Vance

257.comment: Continental Council envoy Marcus Hargrave Xenoria
257.content: Marcus Hargrave Xenoria: huge snow-white leonid gold-ranker in biker leather (Unquenchable flame; advised by Danielle Geller), Continental Council envoy; strips sinecure Adventure Society memberships in Yaresh, extends monster-surge policy. The Aristocratic Faction (merchant barons and old money; led by Gormanston Bynes, core-free gold fortress-like; niece Juniper Bynes, silver; Calcifer Bynes director of External Affairs) runs Yaresh; Gormanston wants to 'drydock and burn the ship'. AS director Musin Heath (elf, gold core user) supports Jason. Lord Warthington-Hampstead (Magic Society) tries to seize Schaat's orb; Humphrey humiliates him.
257.name: Continental Council envoy Marcus Hargrave Xenoria

258.content: Council of Kings (Book 10 Ch15): a meeting of astral kings aboard a dimension ship near a dying universe, where the Builder's world engineers wrap a lush green-blue planet in intrinsic-mandate magic to move it to a fresh universe as payment to astral kings. Participants: Jamis Fran Muskar (prime avatar of an astral king; hedonistic 7-ft celestine-like with dark copper hair; says Jason is no threat and calls astral kings who aren't messengers 'originals'), Vesta Carmis Zell (Yaresh king; wants a second soul forge and Jason dead after use), the new Builder's prime vessel Erigo Fin Desca (ex-messenger and ex-Unorthodoxy; silver metal wings, amber glass eyes). Purification artefact is the council's goal. Zithis Carrow Vayel is the Builder's name.
258.name: Council of Kings

259.content: Colin hatches in Book 10 as Jason's Voice of the Will (a bonded avatar): four forms - Swarm (more biomass and hive range), The Worm That Walks (rags/leather straps entangle), Apocalypse Beast (headless four-armed mouth-covered blood giant ~2x Humphrey, later 8-armed eye-mouthed sphere; feeding seals enemy powers) and Voice of the Will (looks exactly like Jason with red-ember eyes in a void; Jason-level intellect; uses most of Jason's abilities except astral-hegemon ones; influence over branded messengers). The system calls Jason a 'Nascent Astral Hegemon' (variant astral king). Colin's cocoon in the astral kingdom is a glass sphere. Stash welcomes him.
259.name: Colin - Voice of the Will

260.content: Jali Corrik Fen: perpetual-silver female messenger (born at the limit), expendable envoy who delivers the messenger device; has quietly shed indoctrination; her astral king notices and tries to kill her (gestalt tears itself) but Jason shields her with astral-gate authority; she enters his realm, remakes her inner torture castle into a cenote garden, erases her brand by sitting on the throne herself and flies. Gary hostilely puts her to work cleaning his smithy. She is one of the freed newborn messengers in Book 11 era.
260.name: Jali Corrik Fen

261.comment: Tera, Marek and the Unorthodoxy in Jason's realm
261.content: Tera wakes in Jason's astral kingdom with her brand and silver cap gone and flees in horror; Marek (Unorthodoxy) explains. Jason remoulded misbehaving messengers' bodies (Mari Gah Rahnd lost mouth/arms/legs/wings for days). Marek's people have a Soviet-concrete-block inner world; Jali a fairy-tale castle; Jason offers freed messengers the choice of release into the cosmos via the goddess Liberty's priestess Raelia Cass.
261.name: Tera, Marek and the Unorthodoxy in Jason's realm

262.content: Boris Ket Lundi (Boris Ketland): gold-rank messenger of the Unorthodoxy, from Earth (spent far more time on Earth than Jason; a founder and global leader of the Cabal, posing as a Cabal/government counterpart of Darius and Michael); sold by his true astral king to Vesta Carmis Zell to ensure Jason succeeds; a block holds his brand ~12 days; claims best astral-magic specialist on the planet (Jason second) and 'best lover in the cosmos'. Gabriel Remore rescues him from the death-chamber gate. In Book 11-12 he helps with Earth, vampire war, and the Slovakian meeting.
262.name: Boris Ket Lundi (Ketland)

263.content: On the fifth floor of the Cardinas death-chamber wall the god Hero (leonid-aspect, gentle voice, calls Gary 'Gareth') offers the Cup of Heroes; Gary has 7h41m for his soul to contain the power. His body becomes a gestalt: Hammer -> Divine Hammer, Fire -> Divine Fire, Iron -> Divine Iron, Forge confluence -> Demigod essence. Abilities: All-Seeing Eye, First Son of the Leonids, Vessel of the Ancestors (grow to giant size), Divine Forge, Hero (aura: all attributes up, cooldown reset, DR, resist, cleanse, regen, divine protection). He rises from gold 0 through gold 9 to diamond 0, golden eyes, forges Divine Armour, six Large Hammers and Gary's Last Hammer, and fights the avatar of Undeath kaiju-style. It is irreversible ('doesn't come back from the dead'); sacrifice was his choice; in Book 11 he dies ~1 year later.
263.name: Gary's Cup of Heroes (Book 10)

264.content: Hero (god; appears human in plain armour): his influence is by role/mandate; his miracle is offered to heroes at their darkest moment; three times Jason met the conditions. Hero gives Jason [Genesis Command: Source] (transcendent legendary, 1/1): assign or reassign a source of power - like the Healer's Genesis Command: Life. Hero's power returns to him after Gary's death unless reassigned (Jason's hint that 'this time the one who gets the choice is you'). Hero on Purity: a human-dominant empire's 'purity' war led to the Order before Disguise took over.
264.name: Hero and Genesis Command: Source

265.comment: Gods meeting Jason: Knowledge, Destruction, Dominion
265.content: Destruction (rumbling avalanche voice) takes over priests holding a messenger beacon and kills them. Knowledge (bookish woman in brown robes) advises that Jason can trigger a zone again as sacred ground; says Beaufort's intentions are honest. Dominion interrupts a meeting ('Sod off'). Jason is unaffected by the general divine will of gods (the nascent astral king excised him from their power over mortals of that world); gods can still affect him in their own sphere.
265.name: Gods meeting Jason: Knowledge, Destruction, Dominion

266.content: Mah Go Schaat's study (orb the size of a small cottage atop a stronghold tower) is delivered to Jason via a convoy; a keystone from Schaat's body (imbued with astral-king ambitions) opens it; inside only research, no relics: astral-magic secrets for finishing the dimensional bridge. Marek warns all diamond-rankers self-resurrect (Schaat will return). Allayeth impales the messenger servants who delivered it.
266.name: Mah Go Schaat's study

267.content: Shade explains fate senses (Eyes of the Crucible, Way of the Crossroads): unconscious senses of important events; conditions: near-inert low-rank soul, malleable state (yanked through astral), close encounter with a maximally powerful force. Jason's Quest System was his fate sense; it evolved into sensing Gordon's potential for intrinsic-mandate magic (high-order magic of transcendent entities that shapes reality: the Builder forging worlds; World-Phoenix hardening Earth's barrier). The World-Phoenix token was intended to instil fate senses; not everyone survives.
267.name: Jason's Fate Senses (Quest System)

268.comment: Taika, Fertility church and Church of Liberty (Book 10)
268.content: Fertility priestess Hennith (acolytes Fennick and Cassa) wants samples for a breeding programme (anti-messenger forces); Taika flees ('creepy eugenics'). Priestess Raelia Cass (human, silver, Church of Liberty) works with Allayeth: Liberty approves freeing messengers but they must be released into the cosmos; Liberty will hide Jason's actions from Knowledge. Liberty is antagonistic to Dominion.
268.name: Taika, Fertility church and Church of Liberty (Book 10)

269.content: Amalgeth: intelligent shape-shifting fungal monster that infiltrates isolated communities, learns, and slowly escalates predation timed with monster activity; killed people become mutable flesh; exposed it rampages, spawns a fully grown copy with memories and triggers accelerated plant growth. Starts at silver, advances to gold with reproduction. Allayeth killed one.
269.name: Amalgeth

270.comment: Thadwick the Energy Vampire in Jorganis
270.content: Thadwick (now an energy vampire, former Thadwick Mercer) leads a vampire coterie in Jorganis (lawless island city, Pacific-equivalent) where messengers have moved in; he killed a gold messenger with the black-and-red messenger-killing sword (sealed by the Builder; he devoured the soul containing it) and asks about the Purity relic.
270.name: Thadwick the Energy Vampire in Jorganis

271.content: Jason's soul realm by essence: rose garden (blood; smells of immortality), underground mushroom caverns (dark), rope-bridge gorge with mana creeks, farmhouse where Tera perches, vampire-manor estate (dark+blood; man-eating hedges, clocks with old symbols), the Flesh Pit (recreated sacrifice chamber), the Colin greenhouse, library avatars, a door sign 'The Astral Gate Containment Centre and Standish Family Adult Recreation Retrospective'. Mana flows in creeks; the Builder's flaying taught him soul attacks. He can stabilise any physical reality he is inside.
271.name: Jason's soul realm tour

272.comment: The Rexion hold-outs: Gary and Farrah (Book 10)
272.content: Farrah was resurrected by the Reaper at the World-Phoenix's request because the World-Phoenix feared Jason would let Earth die. Her status shows 'Voice of the Will (Nascent)'. She leads array knowledge; Farrah says Earth's grid is an artificial array using natural-array principles at planetary scale, probably developed by messengers.
272.name: The Rexion hold-outs: Gary and Farrah (Book 10)

273.comment: Storm Kingdom royals: Zara in Book 10
273.content: Zara (copper hair cut short after Jason ordered her to change it) apologises for the mess in Rimaros; Jason says he is 'trying out forgiveness as a philosophy'. They share half-flirtations (Ch88). Zara refinances Yaresh debts for Jason (including Bellory's) using House Nareen.
273.name: Storm Kingdom royals: Zara in Book 10

274.comment: Jason's relationship attitude and Earth guilt
274.content: Jason says on Earth he publicly executed people (family grew reticent; Ian is a doctor he hoped to bring); lover, brother and friend were killed. His rage returns when he learns Gary drank the Cup of Heroes; Farrah scolds him; Rufus: 'Is that what it feels like every time I—' 'Yes.'
274.name: Jason's relationship attitude and Earth guilt

275.comment: Genesis Command: Life requires a Soul Forge
275.content: Healer's [Genesis Command: Life] says 'You do not meet the qualifications to activate this device in the current space. Missing element: soul forge.' So Jason's realm lacks a soul forge until Book 11's reintegration.
275.name: Genesis Command: Life requires a Soul Forge

276.content: Book 10: Punish Silver 5 42%; Verdict, Feast of Absolution, Hegemony etc. at Silver 4-5; Appendix I lists silver abilities: Dark - Midnight Eyes, Hand of the Reaper (numerous arms), Cloak of Night (flight, space distortion), Path of Shadows (continental portals), Shadow familiar (31 bodies); Blood - Blood Harvest, Leech Bite (Tainted Meridians), Haemorrhage (Blood From a Stone), Feast of Blood, Sanguine Horror; Sin - Punish (Penance), Castigate (Mortality), Feast of Absolution (wide area), Sin Eater (exceed baseline), Hegemony (downgrades transcendent damage); Doom - Inexorable Doom (Persecution), Doom Blade (sword, Price in Blood), Punition (mana tiers), Verdict (Sanction), Avatar of Doom (Harbinger).
276.name: Jason's Silver 5 ability states (Book 10)

277.comment: Book 11 - Summary (the transformation zone, Cosmic Throne, Jason becomes the System)
277.content: BOOK 11 (Pallimustus and Earth; the zone lasts ~9 months, then Jason's soul battle spans years of outside time - the wiki gives ~12 years): Jason triggers his third transformation zone around Cardinas's natural array and corrupted tree, claims territories (a replica of Casselton Beach in a mountain fortress shaped like his head), frees newborn messengers (Jali, Tera), and builds an alliance of adventurers (Team Biscuit, Rufus's group, Moon's Edge, Emir, Beaufort's Builder cultists, brighthearts under Lorenn and Durrum, Boris Ket Lundi's Unorthodoxy messengers). Nik (his created 'son', Lehenik) is born from the soul-realm rabbit. They defeat the Church of Undeath (Garth Larosse killed through an incompatible messenger heart) and the avatar of Undeath, which Jason sanctions and refines into ghost fire. Jason offers the Tree an informed-consent solution: it is reborn in his soul realm as Arbour with Wood Jason as a nascent Voice of the Will. Gary refuses the natural-array option and dies ~a year later; Hero sanctions himself. Jason reintegrates the zone, gets the Soul Forge, becomes half-way an astral king; Rufus and Taika go to Earth with Boris, where Emi, the vampire war and Elizabeth's campaign unfold. In his soul, Jason fights the great astral beings (the Rumble in the Jungle) to repair the Cosmic Throne; Shade sanctions himself into the Shadow of the Hegemon; Jason rigs the game and sits on the Cosmic Throne: every essence-user in the cosmos sees 'Don't Panic. Everything is going to be fine. Welcome to the System.'
277.name: Book 11 - Summary (the transformation zone, Cosmic Throne, Jason becomes the System)

278.content: Nik (Nik Asano): a spirit-being created by Jason when, during the transformation zone, he subconsciously used Healer's Genesis Command: Life on the soul-realm rabbit construct (a tuxedo-and-top-hat humanoid rabbit with a Jason-installed profanity bleeper who controlled the lightning mesa's weather machine). Named 'Nik' from Basque 'Lehenik' (first); Jason plans to call his soul-realm people the Lehenik. Jason treats Nik as his son. A normal-rank soul; Jason can give power up to silver. Nik ages normally when outside the soul realm; later 3 years old but bronze (Book 11 ch78) trained in Greenstone's Geller programme; essences Technology + Myriad + Vast -> Network confluence (support/hub; the raid-group interface of Book 12).
278.name: Nik / Lehenik (Jason's son)

279.comment: Territories, claims and the zone's collapse
279.content: Zone rules: each territory ≥100 km across; claiming one requires clearing anomalies and the final anomaly boss (drops Stable Genesis Core). Defenders have 117 minutes to arrive after a contested claim or the territory is lost. Claiming more than ~5-6 territories causes anger and paranoia (Gabriel Remore erratic, Amos 5, Lorenn 4); handing territories to Jason gives hangover symptoms. Builder star-seed cultists cope better. The central territory cannot be claimed until all others are unified. After ~5-6 months the borders collapse inward (~1 cm/day accelerating). The Tree territory is ~8 km across with a 12 km-tall tree; crystals in the bark are target points; the boss Voice of the Will is a small wooden replica of Jason in sackcloth that uses a challenge power.
279.name: Territories, claims and the zone's collapse

280.comment: Lorus, Durrum, Kurik and the lightning mesa
280.content: Lightning/storm mesa territory: control room with 11 stations drove drones with lightning; Nik (the rabbit) controls the lightning. Brightheart leaders Lorus (fire, ambitious; killed by Durrum), Durrum (massive earth brightheart, conservative, honourable; vows vengeance on messengers, cultists and priests; Jason gave haven to his family) and best friend Kurik (earth). Builder cultist leader Higgins. Neil and Dustin claim a pastoral turnip-boss territory. Gary later takes the mesa; Undeath's avatar destroys the control room. Clive's weather machine hypothesis links environmental-control territories into one zone-spanning natural-array node network.
280.name: Lorus, Durrum, Kurik and the lightning mesa

281.content: Belinda infiltrates the gold messengers (Galis Jay Vahal and Kol Kelis Vel with silver Cas Vin Baral, subordinates of Kaal/Zell) disguised as the silver messenger 'Relia Vin Vala'; she kills the real one, sets rivalries; Kol kills Galis and claims six territories; Belinda's hidden dormant second ritual under conjured stone explodes and maims Kol; Humphrey and Taika ambush and kill her (drops a Stable Genesis Core Amalgam). Stash plays the 'quiet messenger with bushy moustache'. Belinda's backstory (father a drunk who taught her to read; Old City thief; impostor syndrome). Taika is an ex-drug dealer from Earth.
281.name: Belinda as Relia Vin Vala

282.comment: Council at the fortress and alliance
282.content: At Jason's head-shaped mountain fortress the council (Rick, Arabelle, Miriam, Gabriel, Amos, Zara, Orin, Phoebe, Lorenn, Builder cultists, Marek, Jali) accepts Jason's chain of command by fiat; Lorenn calls him a tyrant ('Edgelord Jason'); freed messengers choose their own marks; elemental messengers' minds clear under Jason. Farrah and Arabelle say his mindset is circumstance, not territories. Jason's office: lava waterfall glass wall, replicas of Dawn's paintings, nine secret exits, trapdoor, self-destruct button gag.
282.name: Council at the fortress and alliance

283.content: Boris's account: messengers originate from original astral kings (not messengers) with no brand and no rank limits; later messengers who transcended became astral kings and instituted the brand, enslaving their kind; the free lost the war; victors' leaders became the Council of Kings; the defeated became the Unorthodoxy (hiding; fewer than 1 million live on Earth as citizens since before the first civilisation, esp. in the Cabal). Brand limits are a function of the brand; diamond messengers can begin to resist it and are dangerous to astral kings. Boris is older than the Jurassic, has an Unorthodoxy astral king's brand to fool Zell (a block holds ~12 days), kills refusing gold messengers (Mahk Den Kahla recruited, Fiola Min Kath plant-manipulator), set up Garth. Mentions Bethlin the Reaver and Zithis Carrow Vayel as rare cosmos-shakers. He agreed with Noreth to hide until the time was right.
283.name: Boris Ket Lundi - Unorthodoxy lore

284.content: Zemravore: rare undead who kills their own aura and steals powers by claiming living hearts (one power per heart; usable at the heart's rank or lower; eventually indigestion). Garth Larosse has four heart sockets (four hearts: extra limbs). He isolates Jason in a dimensional duel castle (Escher geometry, 6 arms 4 legs, 'General Grievous'), using the Moonlight Hound heart (howl converts undeath energy to transcendent light) and a stolen messenger gestalt heart; Boris engineered the incompatibility; Garth explodes. His revenant is finally killed by Team Biscuit. Jameela is killed by Taika.
284.name: Garth Larosse - Zemravore

285.content: Sanctioning: using someone's authority against them by overwhelming will; you can't kill gods, you sanction them. Jason sanctions Undeath's avatar from his cloud palace's maw with Gordon's 3D intrinsic-mandate ritual while Gary chains the avatar; he opens his soul to Undeath's echo and refines undeath authority into death authority with Death's lessons, forging divine ghost fire (risk: becoming Undeath's agent like Gary is Hero's). Colin purges corruption. In soul-space the team fights the avatar's representation with imagination (Voltron etc.); Giant nebulous eyes carve Jason's divine marks. The avatar is destroyed, Undeath's power excised and handed back as a purple marble.
285.name: Sanctioning Undeath's avatar

286.comment: Authority, Will and the Sundering (Clive's lore)
286.content: Clive's lore: authority is the highest order of magic; gods perform miracles; great astral beings (GABs) regulate the cosmos. Will is an active force developed via aura training. The Cosmic Throne was the ultimate authority regulating cosmic forces and GABs; the GABs sundered it for 'industry self-regulation'. Keeper of the Sands (Moments; against the sundering from the start), All-Devouring Eye, Word in the Silence stood apart; Celestial Book and Seeker of Songs were against the sundering; the Reaper supported then regretted it; Legion and Whisper in Corners came around. The nameless GABs are functionaries of cosmic mechanics (life, death, time, matter) who are unbound without the throne. Restoration needs a transcendence method (becoming an 'original' astral king) plus a connection to the Sundered Throne (Gordon, created by the All-Devouring Eye). The throne must be restored and left empty.
286.name: Authority, Will and the Sundering (Clive's lore)

287.comment: Raythe and Velius reveal the throne plan
287.content: Velius (celestine, dark skin, silver afro and eyes) is the prime vessel of the Reaper; Raythe (elf woman) is prime vessel of the Keeper of the Sands/Moments (oldest-serving prime vessel; polices time travel). They tell Jason the Cosmic Throne must be restored and left empty; if Jason's will burns out he'd be a blank pocket universe. The World-Phoenix prefers the throne sundered; the Builder, surprisingly, fights on Jason's side. Raythe killed Schaat to protect Jason (a favour Jason owes). The risk: half-transcendence makes his soul a battleground.
287.name: Raythe and Velius reveal the throne plan

288.comment: The Rumble in the Jungle (soul battle)
288.content: In Jason's liminal soul-space: a 24-lane flagstone road through a jungle labelled 'Rumble in the Jungle'. The great astral beings take mortal forms (silver-rank essence-user rules): Reaper (corpse-pale man, black orb eyes), Celestial Book (cosplay wizard, cheerful), Seeker of Songs (plain dumpy woman with blue-glowing eyes), Whisper in Corners (veiled tall woman in black lace), Legion (tall, mossy green hair/beard, antlers), World-Phoenix (fire-haired golden-skinned woman) and the Builder in Thadwick Mercer's body, later a stonemason. The nameless GABs (cyclopes, hydras, xenomorph-like horde) fight down the road; Jason's side must reach the end; each death respawns further back; losses damage his will. Jason gets to gold rank through these fights.
288.name: The Rumble in the Jungle (soul battle)

289.comment: Shade sanctions himself - Shadow of the Hegemon
289.content: Shade (Progeny of the Reaper) sanctions himself using authority gathered over tens of thousands of years: Shadow of the Reaper becomes Shadow of the Hegemon (Gold 0; permanent contract; 211 bodies); he accepts avatar status from Jason; the Reaper calls him Progeny, estranged ('I felt nothing'). Shade as 'power behind the throne'.
289.name: Shade sanctions himself - Shadow of the Hegemon

key: everything is going to be fine
290.comment: Jason's rigged win and sitting on the throne
290.content: After two outside-years Jason seems defeated: the World-Phoenix wins and his aura vanishes (vampires overrun Asano domains). The reveal: his willpower was siphoned into the nested soul (the tree city/Arbour) where the GABs couldn't sense it; he used it to restore the Throne ('embezzling my own soul'); he offered the GABs young arrogant vessels; he threatens ten free resurrections for everyone; he chooses mercy over refining their will strands into authority (advice from his father). He walks a glowing road with Shade, Colin, Gordon and Arbour to the Sundered Throne's castle (split by an axe), where the GABs' prime vessels wait (Raythe, Velius, All-Devouring Eye's vessel, Helsveth, the Builder). Jason sits on the throne: the Throne is restored and every essence user in the cosmos sees: 'Don't Panic. Everything is going to be fine. Welcome to the System.' The System becomes the cosmos-wide interface administered by Jason.
keys: everything is going to be fine
290.name: Jason's rigged win and sitting on the throne

291.comment: Arbour (Tree person) and the forest city
291.content: The Tree-person (wooden child-like avatar, Wood Jason) agrees to surrender after Jason offers informed consent: the tree is a person with a soul (born from natural array + soul forge, corrupted); Jason extracts the natural array and soul forge and, with its consent, places its soul into a new uncorrupted body. Planted in Jason's soul realm it becomes a forest city of cloud-stuff treehouses, calling itself Arbour; the mountain-head fortress floats above with five doors (office, astral throne, astral gate, soul forge, and a starry void with nebulas incl. Carmen's mountain nebula). The natural array returns to the brighthearts' new spirit domain (exceeds max domain size by 1,743,621%).
291.name: Arbour (Tree person) and the forest city

292.content: After reintegration Jason offers Gary a way to keep living: with the Soul Forge he would strip the divine power and replace it with the natural array's power (immortal while the array exists but confined to the brightheart city, no growth). Gary refuses ('I don't want to be a ghost rattling around in a hole') and chooses to let go. Rufus storms out. Almost a year after becoming a demigod, Gary dies in Jason's realm (golden light and rainbow smoke leave an empty chair) after a memory hallway and a farewell meal; Hero sanctions himself, making dead demigod heroes' relics usable by others temporarily. Gary's soul is reborn: Velius shows Rufus a leonid newborn named Gary in the clan ward (a different person; Rufus must not try to make him old Gary). Hegemon's Will/Dominion are reforged as growth relics.
292.name: Gary's choice and death

293.content: After Gary's death Hero tells Farrah and Gary 'all I do is kill heroes' and sanctions himself: relics of dead demigod heroes become usable by others temporarily, a less costly option than the Cup of Heroes. Gwydion Remore (Rufus's older brother, priest of Hero) asks for Gary's hammer; Gary renames it 'Gary's Medium Hammer'.
293.name: Hero sanctions himself

294.comment: Earth in Book 11: Asano clan domains, Nitra and Saint-Etienne
294.content: Book 11 Earth: the Asano clan (matriarch Yumi Asano, flesh-shaping essences, looks one-third her age; administrator Ketevan Arziani; Hiro, Ken, Shiro, Erika, Ian, Emi) lives in Jason's astral-space domains: Saint-Étienne (France; refugee city for transformed non-humans) and Nitra (Slovakia; steampunk towers, zeppelins, pagoda with blue-orange eye, portal aperture; steam on fire/water quintessence). Walls rust and monsters rise as Jason struggles; turrets blaze when he is winning. Vampires hold most of mainland Europe; Cabal holds UK/Scandinavia; Network set up in Greenland; Sulawesi and Papua declared independence. Craig Vermillion hides with the clan. Velius works as fertility doctor.
294.name: Earth in Book 11: Asano clan domains, Nitra and Saint-Etienne

295.content: Rufus (silver, afro now) and Taika cross to Earth with Boris and hundreds of messengers (Marek's group, Jali, Tera) via an 'aura egg' dimension bubble. They emerge at the Australian Asano Circle site where Lenora Coleman and Barry Sinise monitor; Cabal's Bruce Montgomery (ogre) meets them; Boris addresses the UN; two jets to Nitra. Rufus becomes Emi's instructor: 'My family runs a school.' He leads Clan training ('Instructor Remore'), kills manticores and gold monsters alone. Emi's first essences at 15-16: Vast, Myriad, Harmonic -> Resonant (not Unity: combos vary after sundering).
295.name: Rufus and Taika on Earth (Book 11)

296.content: Emi Evans-Asano (born ~Book 4 age 12; 15-16 at her essence ritual; 19 in Ch83): essences Vast, Myriad (two legendary) and Harmonic (epic) -> Resonant confluence (the first example where the confluence differs from expectation, Unity). Combat rituals (rare), ritual shields, Matrix Beam (Consolidate Mana). Friends: Lina Karadeniz (Asya's cousin; Karadeniz family blames Jason). Emi's parents Erika (food logistics director) and Ian (medical director). Rufus insists she isn't an adventurer.
296.name: Emi's essences and ritual specialisation

297.comment: Sophie, Humphrey and Team Biscuit after Jason leaves (Book 11)
297.content: Humphrey and Sophie become engaged. Sophie leaves Team Biscuit to 'follow the wind' (path to gold): not coming back until Humphrey comes to find her; she keeps Farrah and Travis's comms device. Humphrey searches for his dragon essence ('dragons do what they want'); Stash runs a student cheating racket and 'The Pastry Stash' patisserie in Vitesse (manager Janice). Belinda breaks up with Jory Tillman and is with Estella Warnock. Neil breaks up with Cassandra Mercer. Zara is a temporary member. Clive and Belinda raid the Magic Society Archive Vault (Pochard Finn is forced to cooperate) and Clive publicly releases the archive. Clive becomes Archchancellor of the Magical Research Association; Belinda teaches 'Practical Use of Ritual Magic in the Field' at Remore Academy.
297.name: Sophie, Humphrey and Team Biscuit after Jason leaves (Book 11)

298.content: Earth's vampire war: vampire lords (ancient gold) led by Elizabeth (eats those who ask if she's Báthory) hold Europe from Venice; the Cabal's human-friendly vampires hold refuges only in Jason's Nitra astral space (Craig calls for refugees); humans nuked Rome with a sunlight weapon from Travis's design; Elizabeth retaliated with a Russian nuke on Guangzhou; war formally declared; blood farms; Americas scoured by the Network; Cabal dominant in Asia/Russia/Africa/Americas/Pacific. Gerling's body is Elizabeth's blood slave with his soul trapped. Barnabus Cope (rival vampire lord) occupies Asano territory; Élie advises; the British Isles remain free. When Jason's aura vanishes after the World-Phoenix defeats him, vampires overrun the clan's domains; the clan hides for ~2 years.
298.name: Vampire War (Earth, Book 11)

299.content: The World-Phoenix was formerly the GAB 'the Boundary'; it sanctioned itself to become the World-Phoenix (red hair, white clothes with orange, fire wings in mortal form). The Cosmic Throne resisted the change; the sundering freed her. She experiences time as events, regrets fighting Jason, admires him, glad she sent Dawn. Hierophants are former vessels who still serve (Dawn). Helsveth is the current prime vessel. Restrictions from the sundering unravel as Jason repairs the throne (e.g., essence combos).
299.name: World-Phoenix reveal: the Boundary

300.comment: Gabriel and Arabelle trapped; Carlos and Melody; Jaime and Rhett
300.content: Soul-realm residents: Melody Jain (treehouse estate with a research centre for Carlos Quilido), Gibson Amouz (in coma for a decade), Order-of-Redeeming-Light members Jaime and Rhett (planning an amphora shop), Gabriel and Arabelle Remore (trapped since portals closed years earlier), freed messengers, brighthearts, Arbour's forest city. Jason's mortal body dissolves into rainbow smoke when he leaves.
300.name: Gabriel and Arabelle trapped; Carlos and Melody; Jaime and Rhett

301.content: Before departing for the battleground Jason says goodbye: Gary reforges Hegemon's Will and Dominion from silver growth to silver growth RELICS (owner always knows location, can't be used without permission, summonable to avatars/servants, indestructible, re-manifestable). Neil is 'the most important member'. Jason tells Humphrey and Sophie about a plan involving 'a king with big hair'. Jason also removes the star seeds from Beaufort's Builder cultists (they become human; handed to the Adventure Society as victims).
301.name: Climactic farewells of Book 11

302.comment: Hana Shavar, Gwydion Remore, Trenchant at the shaft
302.content: At the bottom of the Yaresh shaft after the zone: Danielle Geller (dimension essence, gold) and Gwydion Remore (Rufus's older brother, priest of Hero, dark skin, curly hair, cheats at cards: 'Heroes cheat'), Trenchant Moore with the Sapphire Crown, Raythe and Velius; Undeath ('Steve') appears and Jason tosses him the purple marble and rescinds his invitation. Lorenn awakens in the new brightheart home: growth chambers, array-powered forges and hot springs, and a spherical citadel of white marble under a 2 km ceiling with two orbs of white fire as suns.
302.name: Hana Shavar, Gwydion Remore, Trenchant at the shaft

303.comment: Jason's Earth family during Book 11 and the Rumble
303.content: Jason sends a recording to Emi ('Hey, Moppet... the grim reaper has recruited me to fight a giant space bird... I'm becoming immortal... kind of a god for the angels'). He later projects an avatar (a boy, Vincent) to Emi while she solves nine runic cubes.
303.name: Jason's Earth family during Book 11 and the Rumble

304.comment: Mr North's EOA vault and misc Earth items
304.content: Mr North left an EOA vault to Jason beneath Farrah's accumulator; the clockwork-core source went missing; EOA collapsed with funds siphoned.
304.name: Mr North's EOA vault and misc Earth items

305.comment: Book 12 - Summary (the System, prime avatar, Boko, Cyrion, Earth return)
305.content: BOOK 12 (~16-17 years after Jason left Earth for Pallimustus; ~20-21 years after he first arrived on Pallimustus): Jason wakes seven hours after sitting on the Cosmic Throne; the GABs have left; his interface is now the System available to all essence-users. His true body is a universe (a single planetary system with Arbour as the only developed city; a space station shaped like his head is his seat). He needs a prime avatar; he strips reality-core power from vampires in his Saint-Étienne domain (the 'Bleed for me' purge) and from Death gets back his stored resurrection power. The prime avatar (nature: prime avatar of an astral nexus) has the gifts Prime Avatar, Numen, System Administrator, Sacred Phoenix, Relics of the King and Palanquin. He visits Rexion (brightheart city), Carlos saves Gibson Amouz, Farrah becomes an immortal Defier of the Will, Cloudweaver (the flask maker) tests him, Danielle becomes his political advisor, Anna Tilden is recruited, a Segurado messenger attack gets him called 'the Heretic King'. In Boko an assassin's Lesser Celestial Gorger drains him, Boko (~90,000 people) is evacuated, and a messenger host is annihilated by the ghost-fire phoenix; Jamis Fran Muskar agrees to free all messengers in occupied territories. Jason withdraws the System from slave-law regions after Cyrion's nobles hold Earthlings hostage. 74 Earthlings are gathered; the Sky Link bridge is calibrated; Jason makes a Burning Violet attempt; sails to Earth, defeats Jota Withers's pirates at the Australian Dimensional Artefact Site and reunites with Emi. Ends with 'Hey, Moppet.'
305.name: Book 12 - Summary (the System, prime avatar, Boko, Cyrion, Earth return)

306.comment: Prime Avatar, Numen and System Administrator
306.content: Jason's prime avatar (Book 12): a physical+spiritual gestalt with no soul of its own, an anchor for his transcendent power; made from reality material (naked, hairless, template adjusted for gold). Nature: Prime Avatar of an Astral Nexus (a nexus of astral kings, GABs and gods). Inherent gifts: Prime Avatar; Numen (divine aspects: establish spiritual domains; Akashic Speech; strip and transform remnant magic from killed magic entities; immune to rank suppression and detection/tracking/assessment; negate aura-related abilities by suppressing the user's aura); System Administrator (all System aspects, maps, voice/image chat, party/raid, assess; grant extras; access others' interfaces with permission or after suppressing their aura); Relics of the King (limited astral throne, gate, soul forge; stabilise dimensional spaces; exceed portal limits at cost; suppress spiritual manipulation); Sacred Phoenix (afflictions can add Ghost Fire; on lethal damage become a ghost fire phoenix; 1-year cooldown reduced by absorbing life force); Palanquin (Shade/Colin/Gordon forms of transport). Avatar death costs only time (a 'quarter-century time-out'); it cannot leave his domain... (later it does on Earth).
306.name: Prime Avatar, Numen and System Administrator

307.comment: Akashic Speech and the Old Language
307.content: Akashic Speech: the voice of vessels of gods and astral beings; understood by all things capable of communication as if the soul were listening; everyone hears it in their own language. Jason's speech is now in the 'old language' (used by his sword's name and the Mark of Sin brand). Carlos notices his speech carries authority. His prime avatar is a 'hole in the universe'.
307.name: Akashic Speech and the Old Language

308.content: To make a prime avatar, Jason strips reality-core power from vampires: a giant nebulous eye in the sky of Saint-Étienne drives vampires, ghouls and blood servants mad; incantations: 'BLEED FOR ME', 'YOUR BLOOD IS NOT YOURS TO KEEP, BUT MINE ON WHICH TO FEAST', 'MINE IS THE JUDGEMENT, AND THE JUDGEMENT IS DEATH'. Blood mist is drawn into the eye; shadow arms drain; blood rain of gold-silver-blue motes explodes ghouls; ghost flame cleans up. Only vampires who consumed reality-core-infused blood lose it. Nigel Thornton witnesses. The same purge occurs in Slovakia; the blood farm there is liberated; Jason says 'This is who I am when I have to be.'
308.name: Saint-Etienne Vampire Purge (Book 12)

key: Orange Darce Higgy Digit Woolzy Cobbo Jonno Green
309.content: Nigel 'Thorny' Thornton: first gold-ranker outside the US to reach gold without cores; leads a nine-person ex-Network paramilitary team (Orange, Darce, Higgy, Digit, Woolzy, Cobbo, Jonno, Green; mostly silver, core-users), contract operatives for Anna Tilden, spying on former Asano land at Saint-Étienne; wants to join Clan Asano; Rufus liberates a blood farm with him. Jason offers to ask Yumi to take them. Nigel later is Anna's close friend and joins the clan.
keys: Orange Darce Higgy Digit Woolzy Cobbo Jonno Green
309.name: Nigel Thornton (gold)

310.content: Rexion: the brightheart city named after the Cardinas rebuild; Lorenn is still Council Leader; Marla is military leader (molten-steel hair/eyes; asks 'Did you eat that mountain shaped like your head?'); Fiorella (militia) escorts Jason; Bernice (silver-haired metal-aspect customs attendant) makes Jason queue for papers; Outer Rexion is a town in the second (messenger-dug) shaft with a subterranean 'Las Vegas' ring and a Worship Ring (statue of Gary as a leonid hero). The portal had closed for a few years (while his aura vanished) and reopened. Population grew via Church of Fertility children and trade; Jason withdraws dominion over parts of the city so temples can be built; the city's astral space contains a messenger birthing planet producing elemental 'children, not corrupted' in a kilometres-tall tree (sealed). Lorenn: Jason says 'Fame isn't a prize, it's a price.' Statue of Gary exists.
310.name: Rexion and Outer Rexion

311.content: In Book 12 Ch8 the goddess Death returns the stored resurrection power Jason traded ('I will return what was taken now that it cannot be used for its original purpose'); he may build a Death temple in Rexion regardless. Jason is fully immortal now: no conditional resurrections; prime avatar replaceable.
311.name: Death returns the resurrection power

312.content: Carlos Quilido's procedure (Ch9): physically manifest the tainted Order of Redeeming Light magic and cut it out; 7 hours; Jason suppresses death/pain; dark single-eyed avatars assist; Jason absorbs the avatar's decade-plus memories. Gibson (son of Cassin Amouz, whose wealth funded the research) is saved. Carlos's research (~15+ years): vampirism cure works only for lesser vampires. Melody Jain is treated later with Arabelle and Neil (success).
312.name: Carlos saves Gibson Amouz

313.content: Cloudweaver (they/them): diamond-rank gender-fluid shape-shifter, maker of the cloud flask, waited ~two decades; the diamond community sent them to test whether to 'put Jason down'; Jason pulled the flask into his soul, pushing out their back-door control. Cloudweaver upgrades the flask with Travis's weapons; works with Clive and Travis at the MRA. 'Diamond-rankers go to war; only they survive.'
313.name: Cloudweaver

314.content: Magical Research Association (MRA): open-access research body founded by Clive Standish (Archchancellor) with Vice Chancellor Lorelei Grantham (female; likes Clive), assistant Jeff; rivals the Magic Society; runs sky/satellite comms and a transportation network; Yaresh branch has a test facility and mirage-chamber operations (Munsen apprentice artificer; supervisor Roberto 'Bob'). Clive throws spies through the ceiling (Mickel, Herbert Norris ex-Vice-Dean of Alchemy). Clive's aura-analysis headband replicates Jason's interface.
314.name: Magical Research Association (MRA)

315.comment: Sky Link Company and Sea of Storms island
315.content: Sky Link Company (Farrah and Travis): global telecommunications by relay towers and storm accumulators; headquartered in the Storm Kingdom; owns the uninhabited island in the Sea of Storms (colourful town, windmill-like accumulators) with the Builder's hidden infrastructure excavated and sealed; the underground ritual stones there calibrate the Pallimustus end of the bridge to Earth (needs Jason; stable usable bridge after ~a decade). Competes with the Magic Society's water link. Mariska Headingway threatened by Travis in the Cyrion arc ('reason eighty-seven').
315.name: Sky Link Company and Sea of Storms island

316.comment: Farrah chooses Defier of the Will
316.content: On Refuge (Jason's island in his planet: beach, over-water bungalows, rainforest, waterfalls; no powers work, speed/strength capped; Shade bartends) Farrah's window says Jason has half-ascended to Astral Nexus and offers VOICE OF THE WILL (access to his power, subject to dictates) or DEFIER OF THE WILL (negate the Astral Nexus's influence; he cannot harm her; can negate his prime avatar and isolate areas within his domains but not the astral kingdom; immortal; no access to his power). Farrah accepts Defier (Ch22: asleep, immortal, still silver, a step or two from gold). Jason dubs the bond not a familiar link.
316.name: Farrah chooses Defier of the Will

317.content: Danielle Geller (the 'Time Witch of Vitesse') becomes Jason's political advisor on Earth ('do the opposite of every instinct'; 'diplomacy is war'); advises an org chart; her husband is Keith Geller. Dominion advised Jason: 'king or god'. Jason's objective: use power for problems others can't/won't, with trusted help (a Justice League-style think tank).
317.name: Danielle Geller as political advisor

318.comment: Dominion's advice and Projection Command: Presence
318.content: Dominion (god) tells Jason: 'I am not a ruler; I am the very concept of ruling... not a hegemon but hegemony itself'; 'there is no divine right of kings'; gives [Projection Command: Presence] (transcendent legendary consumable: control the presence of your transcendent power). On Earth: 'No half measures' - rule or stand above; 'try not to bring down civilisation'. Knowledge can peek into the prime avatar's head but not his true self.
318.name: Dominion's advice and Projection Command: Presence

319.content: Miguel Ladiv: Adventure Society shaft traffic official, nephew of Vidal Ladiv (deputy director of the Rimaros branch), drafted by Jason as Adventure Society liaison; afraid of transparent floors on Jason's cloud ship.
319.name: Miguel Ladiv

320.comment: Prince Valdis duel and the Yaresh mirage arena
320.content: Team Shining Scabbard (Mirror Kingdom): leader/healer Sigrid Freyn and husband Prince Valdis (Mirror King's son; sword master; Mind's Eye, afterimage force constructs, Seeker Blade, Cross Slash, Blade Wave Barrage, Sword Soul absorbs afflictions). In the Yaresh mirage-chamber arena (commentators Ted and Ned; sponsor Barrington's Barrels) Jason's prime avatar fights Valdis: Midnight Eyes suppresses light; shadow arms hold daggers; Hegemony gives Sin to attackers; Punish, Leech Bite, Ruin; Cloak of Night gold becomes a portal to a dimensional space absorbing attacks; Valdis yields when Sword Soul empties. Sophie once beat Valdis by accelerating time. Other teams: Blood and Gold (Gabriel, Arabelle, Emir), Moon's Edge.
320.name: Prince Valdis duel and the Yaresh mirage arena

321.content: Segurado (Uruguay-equivalent small city-state): messengers with summons (eyes in metal rings, bone cubes with mouths, cages of arms) attack; General Millicent Marks (elven gold wind caster) is saved when Jason's eye-shaped cloud ship (huge eyeball in dark red armour with satellite orbs shooting butterflies) arrives; messengers scream 'heretic king'. Jason poses as 'John Miller, team cook'. Navise Den Rigal (Voice of an Unorthodoxy astral king who had slipped Boris into Zell's service) is exposed.
321.name: Segurado and the Heretic King

322.content: Dragon Lands (Antarctica-equivalent): draconian homeland with volcanoes, 'dragon mouth' geysers, apertures to a fire realm and the richest farmland (second-largest Greenstone export); xenophobic. Zara rebuffed a draconian prince (87th in line) who wanted her as fourth wife; Belinda imprisoned him; Zara put storm magic inside him.
322.name: Dragon Lands

323.content: Greenstone ~15-20 years after Book 1: Madam Jennifer Landry died 7 years earlier; her daughters own 5 establishments. Elspeth Arella, still Adventure Society director, fears Jason's revenge; a statue of Jason is hidden behind a bush. Jason clears every delta contract overnight; visits Vincent Trenslow (immaculate moustache) in his bathrobe; Hiram (old, bronze) monitors the water aperture. Arrival ceremony features the Davone and Standish families. Adris Dorgan is Old City mayor. Li Li Mei is exposed as the mastermind of a rural 'folk-populist' movement.
323.name: Greenstone visit (Book 12)

324.content: Li Li Mei: Chinese Earth refugee, silver core-user who ran a protection-racket-like populist manipulation of rural workers in low-magic zones for ~15 years to buy gold-rank monster cores; wants gold; careful aura control. Jason offers to take her to Earth and perhaps employ her; China sent her ~20 years earlier as a honey-trap look-alike. She helps Farrah gather Earthlings; Shade extracts her from Adventure Society interrogators (Glen Costling and Glennis).
324.name: Li Li Mei

325.comment: Boko assassination and the ghost fire phoenix
325.content: In Boko (dark-skinned desert city; academic arts city north of Greenstone, ~90,000) a man in black-and-red armour stabs Jason with a slab sword (Lesser Celestial Gorger, gold uncommon; absorbs magic from gestalt entities by combining physical+spiritual energy; replica of a more sophisticated weapon) which drains his universe-power and paralyses his avatar. Jason lifts everyone out with his aura and drops them in the desert; Clive and company erect a containment ritual in Onslow's shell; four Voices of the Will of minor astral kings open portals above the city for 'an example'; Jason explodes silent; a perfect sphere of Boko is deleted (only temples remain, floating); System Alert: '[System Administrator] assassinated. The Hegemon has arisen. Beware his wrath.' The ghost fire phoenix (star-speckled dark bird with silver ghost flame) kills ~10,000 messengers. ~98% of Boko survived; hundreds to 2,000 died from his aura.
325.name: Boko assassination and the ghost fire phoenix

326.content: Jamis Fran Muskar (Council of Kings, copper hair, 7 ft, unwinged) tears open the messenger staging area, berates four kings for defying the Council's order not to provoke Jason, and offers Jason a Council seat. Originals (originators) are astral kings who weren't messengers: astral nexus (Jason), astral colossus (planet-sized prime avatar) and astral beast (armies of spawn creatures); messengers invented the 'originals' myth. Jason demands all messengers in occupied territories be freed to him (~quarter million, held in his kingdom); Jamis agrees to try; Jason vows a 'billion-year jihad' to unmake messenger society (burn birthing trees, free slaves). Jamis wants to become an original with the Purity artefact. Astrid Ela Dain (Voice of the Will) supports Jamis.
326.name: Jamis Fran Muskar's deal

327.comment: New Water and the Duke of Boko
327.content: New Water: oasis city of sandstone and green stone with waterfalls built in days in Jason's soul realm for Boko's population; gods Dominion (framework for leadership), Hearth and Refuge will organise it; no aristocracy; Duke Boko (silver by cores, Kalar) is rebuked and banned. Chief Inspector Krensler (Continental Council, dark-skinned, bald) gives Jason a new Adventure Society badge: gold with a diamond symbol (treat by diamond-rank rules). Soramir suggested it; diamonds have 'more or less accepted' him.
327.name: New Water and the Duke of Boko

328.content: Arash: blue-black, glowing-sigil runic juice vendor in Greenstone's Divine Square (Book 1) asks Jason to hire his nephew Jamar (bartender/kitchen manager; couldn't kill monsters); Jason attends Arash's family feast as John Miller.
328.name: Arash and Jamar

329.content: Anna Tilden (Under-Secretary-General at the UN Office of Supernatural Affairs, boss Secretary Shu-Chen Lin; wife Susan) flies to Saint-Étienne with security chief Morris Manning (US Dept of Supernatural Affairs), gold bodyguard Patrick Clovis and French delegate Maël Baffier; four-winged monsters attack the plane; Ketevan Arziani and Rufus greet them. After three days of Q&A with Jason (avatar in an apron who can't taste) she provisionally accepts the job as his political consultant. Jason says he could conquer the world and wants to avoid war. Susan: great astral beings are 'the thing that makes the car work'. Later Jason keeps her out of the pirate plan, then apologises; she lands with Rufus, Taika and Gary Sharpton at the Australian site and meets Lenora Coleman.
329.name: Anna Tilden joins Jason (Book 12)

330.comment: Saint-Etienne in Book 12 and Gary Sharpton
330.content: Book 12 Saint-Étienne: cloud city with canals, parks, Renaissance admin tower; refugees with green scales and wings; Craig Vermillion lives in the Slovakian vampire astral space; Erika and Ian host picnics; Nigel's families joined. Emi (22ish) and Vincent (a boy) are friends of Gary Sharpton, the reincarnated leonid Gary (teenage mechanic/engineer, inventor of a saucer craft), who says 'Mr Asano is crazy awesome'. Terry Tilden is Anna's brother.
330.name: Saint-Etienne in Book 12 and Gary Sharpton

331.content: Cyrion: capital of Estercost and largest city in the world (concentric walls with farmland; Tokyo-meets-Emerald City from the air); the Builder's cult attacked it before the messenger invasion (dormant world-engineer golems outside the walls, picked clean by Clive and Belinda); the Continental Council sits in Vitesse. Earthlings were housed in the Geller compound there. Noble houses use indenture laws as slave laws.
331.name: Cyrion

332.content: Of ~104 Earthlings pulled to Pallimustus, 53 sign up in Cyrion and 74 total return to Earth (~30 stay, are lost or dead). Daryll (Darryl): troll were-crocodile (fae) from Far North Queensland, Cabal member, only non-essence-user among them, blood magic (ropes, hammers, venom). Koa: Māori teen at the pull (mother worked for the Network, now for the Gellers), no cores; Absorb Electricity, Ignite Stone ('Let the heart of the world beat'). Stormspire drakes attack the northern mountain city; Nik leads a raid group; Danielle is raid leader; Jason's cloud ship takes configuration D20 (black icosahedron with eyes).
332.name: Earthlings gathered: Daryll and Koa

333.content: When Cyrion nobles use indenture law to hold Earth-people hostage, Jason sends letters ('promise to myself... wipe out slavery... not a negotiating position') and withdraws the System from slave-law regions with a one-day notice. Belinda (disguised as butler James) and the team poison-scone-kidnap seven nobles (Garret Headingway, Patterson Kennington...) and sell them in Sadi Andali's slave markets (lawless desert east of Estercost). Ben Headingway (top gold of House Headingway) leads raids; Brian, a gold priest of Dominion, buys Patterson to protect him ('Slavery is a petty tyranny; my lord looks higher'). Duke Percival Headingway and business manager Mariska decide to stop antagonising Jason.
333.name: Cyrion nobles kidnapped; Sadi Andali

334.content: Vandrick Macarro (diamond) arbitrates for the Queen of Estercost and says the diamond community considers the System Jason's to administer; diamond etiquette: stand alone, respect the mortal/immortal boundary (after ~500 years step back), everyone gets ONE great world-changing action (Jason's is abolishing slavery via the System). Young diamonds: Allayeth and Charist (Yaresh), Mirror King (Victor Volaire), Roland Remore (via proxies); older: Soramir Rimaros and Dawn (out in the cosmos). Pole slides in Jason's palace are labelled with team names.
334.name: Vandrick Macarro and diamond etiquette

335.content: Jacinta Adeline: Adventure Society Cyrion branch director, drinks with Danielle Geller; says Sophie Wexler is Jason's biggest supporter.
335.name: Jacinta Adeline

336.content: Jota Withers: gold-rank captain from an Interstice feeder universe, working for pirate 'Admiral' Aractus Jakaar (fat, pointy hat, moustache; fleet that plunders low-magic worlds) with first officer Natala Spiro and mutineer Kreegle. The World-Phoenix opened Pallimustus' neighbour Earth to gold-rankers; the Earth secret council (US excluded) invited them to remove Jason, giving them a pretence under the Rules of Intrusion. Jota stays at Asano Village hosted by Noriko, concludes Jason is of consequence, surrenders his ship; Jason forfeits the ship, takes Jota and Natala prisoner (Arabelle interviews them) and the Jakaar mutineers are beaten. Jota reads Jason's System window: 'Prime Avatar (Astral Nexus) [System Administrator]'.
336.name: Jota Withers and Aractus Jakaar

337.content: Rules of Intrusion: cosmic law (enforced by the restored Cosmic Throne, now rigid) on entering worlds that have not declared themselves open to the cosmic community; flexible before, rigid now. Invaders must fulfil the invitation's conditions (remove Jason) or violate the rules. Rufus: they mostly applied to holy wars on Pallimustus, but also govern dimensional invasion.
337.name: Rules of Intrusion

338.content: Dimensional Artefact Site One (the artefact city): ~9,000-person town around the Australian standing stones where Jason and Farrah vanished; hardened for 15 years by a multinational coalition; weapon bunkers with magical howitzers; run by Director of Operations Lenora Coleman (core-user bureaucrat), deputy Barry Sinise (mayor), assistant Cassie, Security Commander Higgins, Sub-Commander Keene; first director Gordon Truffett is now Australian PM. A Chinese bomber failed. Gold-rankers belong mostly to US and China; Lord Willoughby (English Network gold) and a Chinese gold-ranker are on roster.
338.name: Dimensional Artefact Site One

339.comment: Asano Noriko's village and Australian land seizure
339.content: After Jason's clan hid in Europe, the Australian government seized Asano Village and the stone-circle land by eminent domain and gave them to Asano Noriko's Japanese-line 'true Asano clan', allied with the Network faction; Noriko hosts Jota and dismisses the System link ('utter nonsense'). Jason's anger at Lenora: 'The rules of this world... mean that if you have the power, you can take what you like.'
339.name: Asano Noriko's village and Australian land seizure

340.comment: Pirate battle at the Artefact City
340.content: Jason's ship (>300 m, gold/silver/blue light arrival, dark red panels, ring of eye-orbs, gold lyric text on the side) vs the Jakaar pirate ship (~80 m); 23 mutineers (Kreegle's) attack; Jason blots out the sun, dons void-portal cloak and blood robes, spawns 200+ Shade bodies with black-red daggers; Hegemony suppresses 20+ aura powers; Inescapable harpoon blocks shadow jumps; the team (Biscuit + Farrah) arrives (Sophie's Eternal Moment for the team, Belinda's Force Tether, Farrah's Lava Cannon x2 via Mirror Magic, Clive's Wrath on Onslow, Humphrey's Unstoppable Force, Neil's Grand Renewal); Jason's Verdict rain annihilates; he spares pirates (prisoners go to his prison planet with surrendered messenger armies) and halts the dimension-jump with a ship-eye 'No.' Jota says the ship is a temple.
340.name: Pirate battle at the Artefact City

341.comment: Lenora's confrontation and Jason meets Gary Sharpton
341.content: Jason (floral shirt, aura imperceptible then crushing) tells Lenora about the eminent-domain seizure ('You don't threaten a mosquito... you swat it'), refuses to care what governments want, and asks Anna to find a drop-off for returning refugees. He then meets Gary Sharpton ('named for a good friend') and recruits him to explore the pirate dimension ship. He reunites with Emi: 'Hey, Moppet.'
341.name: Lenora's confrontation and Jason meets Gary Sharpton

342.content: Jason applies to the Burning Violet guild in Vitesse; receptionist Monica; Neiman Bassingthwaite warns of factions; Roland Remore arranged it as a lesson/trap to keep Jason out of his fight with 'the order'; Jason retorts 'power rules'; Team Biscuit withdraws; Victor Volaire (Mirror King) and Roland discuss; Roland says Jason has a sense of responsibility and 'deserves a break' until he must get involved.
342.name: Burning Violet application

343.content: Jason meets Cassandra Mercer in Vitesse (20 years later; she is near gold, teaming with Jiralla and Henrietta Geller); they talk about being adventurers ('puts themselves between the bad things and those needing protection'); Neil dumped her; she won't see Neil; Nik hopes to see her.
343.name: Cassandra Mercer reunion

344.comment: Springclaw gorillas and Team Biscuit's gold tactics
344.content: Team Biscuit's gold playbook (Book 12): Humphrey Mighty Strength (enlarges him), Dive Bomb; Sophie speed, healing aura, mirage afterimage implosions; Neil absorb-and-counter summon, Burst Shield; Belinda Instant Adept, Force Tether; Clive top single-target damage, buffs, Onslow battle platform; Zara concentrated storm; Stash tiny mouse that becomes a three-headed carrier. Springclaw gorillas (gold, cunning, anticoagulant venom) defeated by the 'double scoop slam'.
344.name: Springclaw gorillas and Team Biscuit's gold tactics

345.content: Zara restores her sapphire hair and role as Princess Zara Rimaros to abolish indentured servitude in the Storm Kingdom slowly; the Storm King is her cousin (a decade into tenure), her brother Emiliano ('Stupid Emiliano') is mentioned, and her father retired. At the Sky Link island Lord Alberto slights her and she threatens to peel him; Jason's delegation offer (40 people, no diamonds) is on the table. She and Jason have romantic tension (Helen of Troy story). Farrah's boyfriend Trench (Trenchant Moore) wants something serious.
345.name: Zara Rimaros returns (Book 12)

346.comment: Bridge to Earth and expedition members
346.content: Jason's Earth expedition: Team Biscuit, Rimaros delegation (40, incl. Zareen, Liara's daughter), Valdis and Rick Geller with teams, Lorelei Grantham and MRA researchers, Travis and Farrah's employees, Jory with alchemists, clergy for Boko refugees in Jason's astral kingdom (cut off from gods), Gabrielle Pellin (now Travis's wife), Carlos, Melody (recovering), Earthlings. The bridge opens quietly; Jason's cloud ship ferries via the proto-bridge guide wire. Melody Jain wakes after treatment (Carlos soul, Arabelle mental, Neil body).
346.name: Bridge to Earth and expedition members

347.comment: Gabrielle and Travis; Jory and Belinda
347.content: Gabrielle (priestess of Knowledge) is Travis Noble's wife and attends the Earth trip; Jason apologises for disrespecting Knowledge and recalls the tango. Jory travels with alchemists (awkward with Belinda).
347.name: Gabrielle and Travis; Jory and Belinda

348.content: Jason's Slovakian astral space holds a sunless Gothic city (Prague/Istanbul/Batman influences) where Earth's remaining sane vampires live. Craig Vermillion (gold after feeding on vampire lords; locked himself away for years) lives there. Jason plans to move them to a moon in his own solar system with a permanent eclipse where sunlight doesn't cause insanity. Jason intends to kill all remaining vampires outside.
348.name: Slovakian vampire astral space

349.comment: Secret council of Earth and Americans' warning
349.content: Darius Shepherd (US Dept of Supernatural Affairs) and Michael Glasser (State Dept) warn Jason that a secret council of Earth's most powerful states and societies has hired outsiders to remove him; opposition: Australia, China, Indonesia, the UK; Russia and Africa are Cabal territory; Asia split; the US Network is reconciled with the US government and neutral/friendly; Network China (rebranded 'the Network') hates Jason; vampires are a wildcard. Taika, Shiro Asano and Wesley Asano (vehicle essence) escort them; Boris mediates.
349.name: Secret council of Earth and Americans' warning

350.content: Roland Remore: diamond-ranker, arch-chancellor of Remore Academy and Rufus's grandfather (bald, dark-skinned, looks 40, ~400 years old, sword master). Controls Burning Violet through proxies; in conflict with 'the order' (Order of the Reaper) and wanted Jason out of the fight. Rufus waited until 19 for essences.
350.name: Roland Remore

351.content: Jason Asano (Book 12): Nature Prime Avatar of an Astral Nexus; Gold; 38% to diamond. Attributes Power(Blood) G3, Speed(Dark) G4, Spirit(Doom) G3, Recovery(Sin) G3. Essences Dark/Blood/Sin/Doom. Dark: Midnight Eyes G5, Cloak of Night G5, Path of Shadows G4, Hand of the Reaper G4, Shadow of the Hegemon G4. Blood: Blood Harvest G3, Leech Bite G4, Feast of Blood G4, Sanguine Horror G4, Haemorrhage G4. Sin: Punish G4, Feast of Absolution G3, Sin Eater G3, Hegemony G5, Castigate G4. Doom: Inexorable Doom G4, Punition G4, Blade of Doom G3, Verdict G4, Avatar of Doom G4.
351.name: Jason's gold-rank character sheet (Book 12 Appendix)

352.content: Gold effects: Midnight Eyes diminishes light sources; Hand of the Reaper more arms, further away, armed with conjured weapons; Cloak of Night becomes a void portal (extreme ongoing mana); Path of Shadows global portals; Shadow of the Hegemon 211 bodies as aura beacons; Blood Harvest gains Strength of My Enemies/Endless Power; Leech Bite inflicts Thief of Life; Haemorrhage Exsanguination; Feast of Blood Blood Glutton; Sanguine Horror can exceed mass limits; Punish Thief of Spirit; Castigate's Mark of Sin resists cleanse; Feast of Absolution gives allies Resistant+Integrity; Sin Eater consumes allies' curses/diseases/poisons over time; Hegemony no longer splits strength; Inexorable Doom accelerates; Doom Blade sword extra damage per Legacy of Sin; Punition AoE variant; Verdict wide-area; Avatar of Doom butterflies create seeking clouds.
352.name: Jason's gold abilities (Appendix III)

353.content: Stash (Velitraxistaasch), mirage dragon, now ~22¾ years old (home-schooled; hill mouse form in Humphrey's pocket 'chu'; runs The Pastry Stash patisserie in Vitesse; caused flour-silo fires; calls Humphrey 'Da Humphrey'; Gary was best at scratching behind his ears). Wrote Jason a letter (Ch0). Mother is Carlivexistrix.
353.name: Stash's letter and Stash

354.comment: Ketevan Arziani and Asano clan organisation
354.content: Clan Asano (Earth): matriarch Yumi; chief of staff Ketevan Arziani; economy: spirit coins or clan contribution points; basics free (food, lodging, transport, healing, simple clothing), extras cost points; schools; essences sold for points (Jason left supply). Most members are essence-users; confluence combos are unreliable (variety returning). Honorary members: Rufus.
354.name: Ketevan Arziani and Asano clan organisation

355.content: Jason's true body is a universe (single planetary system; blazing sun; habitable Earth-like planet with only Arbour developed; orbital space station shaped like his head with the observation lounge as its eye serving as seat of power, relic reliquary and entry point for dimension-faring visitors). No one can enter without his allowance. His astral kingdom is smaller than the Builder's but immortal. Refuge is an island on that planet.
355.name: Jason's physical universe

356.content: Sophie (gold; wind blades, stonehide lizard herds) reunites with Humphrey (rainbow-scale armour, bomb drops) when Clive summons her to Yaresh; they are engaged. Jason jokingly challenges Humphrey to a duel for her hand.
356.name: Humphrey and Sophie in Book 12
