357.content: Neil and Nik (Jason's son, now silver, calls Jason 'Dad') travel with Team Shining Scabbard in the Mirror Kingdom. Neil ghosted Cassandra 10 years ago; he is 'moping about some girl'. Nik asks for a hug; Jason can't make more Lehenik until at full power; told his sister and grandmother about Nik. Nik later organises the raid group at Cyrion.
357.name: Neil and Nik after Book 11

358.content: Death returns the resurrection power so Jason's prime avatar can be replaced; his pact still prevents him from resurrecting others. Gods cannot enter his dominion; Jason withdraws dominion from parts of Rexion and New Water so temples can be built. Ex-Purity priests (stasis-held centuries, released ~20 years ago) petition for residency; Jason refuses 'Lord/messiah'.
358.name: Death Pact consequences Book 12

359.content: Stormspire drakes: school-bus-sized rock-and-lightning dragons (silver; two gold) attacking the northern mountain city; River Table: vast flatland crossed by waterways, once a mountain range, last Earthling pickup site.
359.name: Gold monsters of Book 12 (tactics)

360.comment: Book 13 - Summary (Earth in 2038; Knowledge's plot revealed; Ascension's Gate)
360.content: BOOK 13 (Earth, year 2038; chapters 950-1024): Jason, gold-rank Prime Avatar of an Astral Nexus (39% to diamond), returns to Australia after ~15-16 years away (he says he hasn't been human for ~20-25 years). He reunites with Erika and Emi, confronts the Australian government (PM Truffett, Solomon Dreyfus, Sue Sheehan) over the seized Asano Village and shows officials his personal universe. The Melbourne Bunker arc: blood oaks and vampire lord Louden are destroyed by Jason, Rick, Valdis, Emir/Arabelle and Callum; Travis defuses the vampire nuke. He negotiates with Anna Tilden's think tank, the Pakistan (Sukkur) manifestation, Network director Marie Finnegan allied with the vampire Elizabeth and scientist Simon McKean (reality-core farming). A Swiss reality-core depository raid; Elizabeth, Marie and Remy are captured; Raythe and Dawn warn of an unwinnable future fight and time loops; Jason offers the world an open-source magic/magitech deal (SESA, the Saint-Etienne Summit Accords). EDJI (Earth Defence Joint Initiative, 47 nations) forms; the Quilido Procedure is released. The final push on McKean's French castle and the blood-root-vine network ends the vampire war: Jason becomes a giant ghost-fire phoenix; McKean and Gerling die. Jason reveals the truth: Knowledge has planned for ~500 years to invade Earth via the bridge. The farewell at the bridge anchor leads to Ascension's Gate: Knowledge takes Gabrielle's divine essence, a pact of ~40 diamond-rankers (Roland Remore, Victor Volaire) stays out of her invasion, Helsveth removes Team Biscuit, and Umber binds Jason's consciousness into his prime avatar, sealing his astral kingdom. Jason vows: 'The next time we meet, Goddess, will be the day you die.'
360.name: Book 13 - Summary (Earth in 2038; Knowledge's plot revealed; Ascension's Gate)

361.content: Jason's briefing at Asano Academy (Ch1016-1017): GABs sundered the Cosmic Throne to avoid regulation; the original Builder created twin universes (Earth and Pallimustus) from a chimera singularity (identical except Palli magic-rich, Earth magic-poor); sanctioned, his power went to a mortal messenger (new Builder). ~500 years ago, unstable Purity was about to sanction himself; Knowledge convinced him to leave a divine relic and delay a new Purity; Disguise took Purity's place with Knowledge's aid; the Order of the Reaper was destroyed by the churches to hide the fake Purity; Disguise recruited the Network founder (an outworlder); Knowledge promised Jamis Fran Muskar's messengers a chance to invade Pallimustus and claim the relic; the founder returned to Earth with magic bargained from messengers, created the Network and Grid as a pressure valve; Noreth betrayed the founder. Raised magic would sustain a god on Earth. The World-Phoenix limited the flow; Knowledge struck a deal to ensure repair. Knowledge manipulated Jason (charm, flirting, 'mistakes') and placed Clive in his path. Noreth's Plan A: wreck the Grid (EOA); Plan B: super-soldier army (Asano Clan). Knowledge would go from goddess of Knowledge to 'just God' of Earth once the bridge opens; she intends a crusade to conquer Earth's faith and Jason's domains. One-third of Knowledge priests are her spies. The only way to stop her is to destroy the bridge, which would destroy Earth (astral storms within decades).
361.name: Knowledge's Plan (500-year invasion of Earth)

362.content: The Earth-Pallimustus bridge: Pallimustus end is the Sky Link island in the Storm Kingdom (annexed by the Church of Knowledge and renamed Ascension's Gate); Earth end is the outback Australian standing-stone site (artefact city). Not in Jason's domains (Noreth warned an invitation would let Knowledge in). It uses cheap silver-rank rituals with spirit coins. Jason created anchors in both worlds, broke the Builder's Door and the World-Phoenix relic, absorbed their power, returned most of it to the Builder and World-Phoenix in exchange for the Builder ending the invasion; he planted the bridge 'seed' with Clive and must finish within months, or Earth would be destroyed within decades. Earth's magic will keep rising to match Palli (enough to sustain one god). Clive and Emi can only stall it.
362.name: The Bridge between worlds (Book 13)

363.comment: Ascension's Gate and Jason's final confrontation
363.content: Final scene (Ch1023-24): Jason's cloud ship reaches Ascension's Gate (Church of Knowledge Holy Army base; standing stones; 12 diamond-rank priests incl. Lucella Carnes). Knowledge appears as a celestine with onyx hair and eyes in a dark blue Storm Kingdom-style dress; tells Gabrielle she'll rule as priestess of 'God'; rips out Gabrielle's divine essence; Gabrielle is taken to the Storm Kingdom by Travis (only an iron-rank replacement essence with her consent can be given). Roland Remore and Victor Volaire (Mirror King) arrive with ~40 diamond-rankers on a dark crude industrial dimension ship: they struck a deal with Knowledge (she won't interfere with their plan to hold gods accountable; they won't interfere with her invasion). Helsveth (new Prime Vessel of the World-Phoenix; red-and-gold draconian First Sister, snow-globe cottage ship) takes Team Biscuit away per Dawn's warning (the World-Phoenix agreement with Knowledge ends when the bridge is complete). Umber (Shade's brother; smoky orange eyes) says his ritual modifications bind Jason's consciousness into the prime avatar and seal his astral kingdom and domain influence; he will be taken to a place 'that isn't a universe'. Jason silences Umber. Jason: 'The next time we meet, Goddess, will be the day you die.' Knowledge: only gods can sanction gods; 'the next time we meet I will be the one true God.' END OF BOOK 13 (Book 14 is the final book).
363.name: Ascension's Gate and Jason's final confrontation

364.content: Umber: Shade's brother (smoky orange eyes), an opportunist fixated on 'blank state' perfection; helped Shade's previous summoner trap Shade in an astral space for centuries to 'teach duty'; Shade severed his link to the Reaper. Umber engineered Thadwick and the Order of the Reaper's jailer-army and arrives at Ascension's Gate to seal Jason; Shade expects Umber to return when Shade is vulnerable.
364.name: Umber

365.content: Pakistan manifestation: a gold-rank manifestation over the Indus near the Sukkur Barrage; Jason (Hegemon aura, white-stone portal) prevents a transformation zone; silver 'gorilla-spiders' and 30 m six-armed three-faced beings appear; Juliet Crowne (US Network). The Network is fragmented into four: US branch, Chinese branch, GDN (lower Network + EOA remnants + Cabal schismatics) and the largest group working with the Australian government. Director Marie Finnegan (Zermatt chalet, lightning fist, acid touch) was secretly triggering transformation zones by sabotaging the Grid with scientist Simon McKean, harvesting reality cores, and allied with the vampire Elizabeth. Pakistan outlawed personal magic as religious affront but embraced magitech.
365.name: Pakistan manifestation and Network factions

366.content: Simon McKean: silver, handsome by magic, Australian Network family, head of Earth researchers in the grid workgroup under Farrah; theory-obsessed ritualist with no ethics; farms reality cores through artificial transformation zones, builds blood oaks, blood parasites and a continent-spanning blood root vine that revives dead vampires and taps raw astral power through the Grid and Jason's bridge. Betrays Marie, leaves Elizabeth and Gerling. His French castle fails; Magdalyn (vampire queen) dies; Jason's phoenix form destroys the vine; his clones and pods explode. His last claim: humanity will rebel against tyrants. He is a 'mirror' of Jason.
366.name: Simon McKean

367.content: Zara (hurricane) and Trenchant Moore capture Elizabeth, Marie and Remy on the North Sea/Scotland coast; they are taken to Jason's black-and-white 1940s-60s noir Vampire City in Slovakia (Craig Vermillion leads the tame vampires: '19 of 20 vampires lost'). Jason offers exile or death; he admits Elizabeth systemised human farming after he failed to kill her. Remy's daughter has a genetic blood disorder; Neil cures it so Remy becomes loyal. Elizabeth says blood magic came from an older outworlder.
367.name: Elizabeth and Marie Finnegan captured

368.comment: Blood oaks, blood parasites and vampire weapons
368.content: Blood oaks: gold-rank blood-red tentacle-root creatures that puppet victims (killing the leader kills the minions) created by Elizabeth's programme; Melbourne Bunker arc: Vampire Lord Louden killed by Colin; Travis defuses the vampire nuke. Blood parasites: red centipede-like things implanted in staff (Tim, Holly Macrossan's nephew). Blood root vine (alchemy plant) is modified into a continent-sized undead network.
368.name: Blood oaks, blood parasites and vampire weapons

369.content: EDJI (Earth Defence Joint Initiative; 47 nations; General Michael Mills, US Army, operational commander; pronounced 'edgy'). The Quilido Procedure (removes monster-core taint, slow; frees silver-stuck veterans) is given only to EDJI signatories; first demo on Nigel Thornton's squad ('The Wild Thornberrys': Higgy, Orange, Jonno, Darce, Cobbo, Digit, Green, Woolzy). SESA: Saint-Étienne Summit Accords, an open-source research-sharing agreement resulting from Jason's world proposal (everything open source; tech used to interfere with others brings repercussions adjudicated by Jason; third-world debt forgiven; lasts ONE decade). Human Augmentation Project (safe EOA-style augmentation without essences).
369.name: Quilido Procedure and EDJI

370.comment: Jason's World Proposal and the Bahrain deletion
370.content: Jason's proposal to world leaders: all magic/magitech knowledge, training centres, reverse-engineering of a dimension ship, open source, repercussions for interference, debt forgiveness; control lasts one decade. Bahrain's government and ruling family vanish overnight (Jason placed them on a prison-planet farm after they suppressed protests with advanced magic weapons).
370.name: Jason's World Proposal and the Bahrain deletion

371.content: Raythe (Keeper of the Sands' prime avatar, dark-skinned elf) and Dawn (now transcendent, phoenix-shaped ship, fire hair) tell Jason of a future fight he cannot win; he might try repeated attempts via a time loop using his link to the bridge and synced time of the two worlds, risking cascading paradox that could wipe out one or two universes. Terms: Jason must hide what she tells him from his prime avatar and not try time manipulation; Raythe will find him when no one else can. Dawn was born in the Sun Palace; she cannot intervene (the World-Phoenix committed). Jason trains to exclude memories and personality from his prime avatar (thus seems cold).
371.name: Raythe and Dawn's warning (time loop)

372.content: Jamis Fran Muskar (copper-haired celestine 7 ft, king of kings, posing as a bronze) approaches Thalia Mercer (gold, Onslaught) to meet Thadwick, now a monster-like entity (not quite diamond) created from the Builder-vessel remnant; Thadwick found the Purity relic (diamond gazebo with vines and white flowers, resists dimensional storage) in the Mirror Kingdom's frozen cave natural array and delivered it to Jamis in an underground bunker; a Knowledge priest told him where. Thadwick hired by Knowledge to harry Jason. Jamis visits Jason's space station avatar, warns that a prime avatar can be locked away to seal an astral kingdom, offers a Council seat and wants to study originals; Jason refuses friendship but gives a recording of Carlos's research.
372.name: Jamis Fran Muskar and Thadwick

key: Foundation for Ethics in Public Policy
373.comment: Jason's return to Earth in Book 13
373.content: Jason hugs Erika on her rooftop garden, admits he was damaged and dangerous when he left; meets Emi (levitating with nine runic cubes), Amy (Kaito's widow, daughters Hana 23 silver and Jace 19 bronze trained by Rufus). PM Truffett ('Other Gordon') rose by fearmongering about magical gender transitions at rank-up and gave Asano Village to the Network; Jason demands a public apology and doesn't burn it. Asano Village becomes a special-interest territory under a multinational org led by Lenora Coleman; the Network version of the Asano clan is expelled. Jason is called a king and refers European territory recognition to Yumi. He says he is 'properly immortal'.
keys: Foundation for Ethics in Public Policy
373.name: Jason's return to Earth in Book 13

374.content: Swiss Network gold Bussinger (Zurich family; golden gauntlets; lightning) has the Tribulation Lightning ability (appeared after the System) which purges her afflictions and slowly removes monster-core residue from her soul (500 years of continuous use needed); Carlos, Farrah, Clive and Emi study it for the Quilido Procedure. Her Swiss depository raid companions: Amstutz (martial artist), Fiona Calloway, Geneva Andros.
374.name: Bussinger and the Tribulation Lightning

375.content: Jason's Slovakia domain: perpetual night, cloud-material buildings, a fox-person child Marija (3 tails), tramlines, the Quilido Centre for Spirit-Body Research (Carlos), board-game wall on Jason's private floor atop the tower (inherited from Greg). Former Order zealots Rhett and Jaime run reception and sell artisanal Pallimustus amphoras. The Saint-Étienne domain is re-planned by Ken Asano (clan urban planner): cars rare, bike clouds, scooters (Raina Williams). Emi is the 'Princess of the Asano clan'; she disseminates an online magical-theory university course by Clive and Farrah. Vincent Baudrillard (silver near gold, Rufus's protégé, Emi's boyfriend) intends to ask Emi to marry him.
375.name: Slovakia Domain 2038

376.content: Jason and Zara kiss on the promenade deck (Ch955) and begin a relationship; Zara advises him to be 'a good lord not a good leader', to let his aura press and stop masking the god voice; they hold hands on his waterfall-house porch swing; she wants to be diplomat-in-chief of the inter-universe delegation; Zareen Rimaros (Liara's daughter) is her lady in waiting. Jason foresees a reckoning between the gods and mortals and plans to break up with Zara on return to Pallimustus ('scheduling callous dumping'). Zara's brother (adopted cousin) Emiliano is the Storm King.
376.name: Zara and Jason (Book 13)

key: That which remains is mine to claim
377.content: Itsuki Tiwari (now gold, affliction specialist; 'That which remains is mine to claim' life-drain keeps vampires dead; envoy to Japan with a Jason shrine) and Akari Asano (gold, sword gift from Valdis) are married; Itsuki moves out for three weeks of marriage trouble (Taika counsels). Itsuki had once travelled with Jason before three companions were killed by Jack Gerling.
keys: That which remains is mine to claim
377.name: Itsuki Tiwari and Akari Asano

378.comment: Nik gold and the raid interface
378.content: Nik Asano reaches gold (stealth power; 11 powers at silver); his hub/mapping power is more precise than Jason's tactical map and relays powers remotely; wears a straw hat with ear holes; acts as overwatch from Stash's bakery branch in Manhattan; jokes he is the last of his kind and wants a girlfriend. Jason, a 'deadbeat dad' for 15 years, is called Dad.
378.name: Nik gold and the raid interface

379.content: Team Biscuit around the Book 13 era: Humphrey (Might/Magic/Wing/Dragon; Spartoi 100 bone-golem warriors; 'found his inner dragon'; team/expedition leader), Sophie (Wind essence, warm cleansing wind healing whole cities; Kolkata 'miracle breeze'), Neil (Growth/Renewal/Prosperity; desert reclamation in Australia/N Africa), Belinda (married Estella; teaches/spies), Clive (Archchancellor; partner Lorelei Grantham), Rufus (Sun and Moon; philosophy/religion studies; dating Dr Hassan Dukhtar), Taika (Garuda), Emir (satisfied at gold), Arabelle (healing former vampires), Danielle (theoretical physics doctorate). Everyone pursues diamond.
379.name: Team Biscuit in 2038

380.content: Anna Tilden built a think tank (UN/WHO/FAO/UNESCO experts) to guide Jason's good works. Holly Macrossan (silver; Gumboot the mangrove star cat) succeeds her as UN Under-Secretary-General for Supernatural Affairs, later liaison to the Multinational Supernatural Response Taskforce; her nephew Tim carried a blood parasite and died. US Sec of State Claire Davney (Danvey), CIA Director Barstow and the President (Mike) decide to befriend Jason; UK SIS Chief Sir Christopher Collier; ASIS DG Macmillan. Michael Aram is Anna's assistant.
380.name: Anna Tilden's think tank

381.content: Boris Ketland: Cabal HQ in the former DR Congo; Unorthodoxy messengers have hidden on Earth since before hominids; Earth was chosen because of the Builder-sanction scandal (Council of Kings avoids it). Boris openly leads the Cabal after the McKean battle (aggressive economic and social programmes; toppled governments). He warns that within a decade the bridge becomes a true passage; he also fears Jamis revealing the colony to the Council of Kings (allowing Orthodox invasion under the Rules of Intrusion).
381.name: Boris in 2038

382.content: Venice is covered by glowing butterflies (blue and orange eye visible from space) and emptied; the Cabal leads reconstruction. A Singapore poster shows Jason motorcycle-jumping off a bridge onto a giant with a cloak; Eliska writes Clive fan-fiction; Earth tech leapt; fossil fuels abandoned; spirit coin farms widespread.
382.name: Venice butterflies and global effects

383.comment: The Pirate Fleet aftermath and Li Chen
383.content: Admiral Jakaar's pirates tried to use gold catspaws to invade Earth; Jason defeated them (footage leaked). Li Chen (Chinese government gold) threw a nuke into an astral space at Shako's urging 20 years earlier; Shako is imprisoned in a chair-prison. Lu Yan (Chinese gold, core-user) is told of a relic fought over on Pallimustus that can purge residual cores.
383.name: The Pirate Fleet aftermath and Li Chen

384.content: The Concierge is a talkative Jason avatar (personality facsimile) who represents him in the tree city and elsewhere; avatars feel like cold rubber and dull emotion. Jason has avatars in three universes; Colin is 'Big C', a small leech on his collar.
384.name: Concierge and avatars

385.comment: Book 13 Thornberry battles and Seoul ambush
385.content: Nigel's nine-member section (Higgy's five floating shields, Jonno's rotary gun, Darce's steampunk flamethrower, Green scout) with Neil and Remy ambushed in Seoul by nine gold vampire lords and a blood oak; Neil's Hero's Moment and Reaper's Redoubt save them. Delia DeWitt (young silver, Global Defence Network, Bangor Wales; Gun/Swift/Trap/Skirmish) fights nine iron lions when Jason saves her bronze team from a vampire curse. Jack Gerling, tainted with undeath after McKean replaced Elizabeth's control, commands blood oaks and wounds Nigel.
385.name: Book 13 Thornberry battles and Seoul ambush

386.content: Outside his realm, Jason is 'just a gold ranker by Palli standards'; portals have cooldowns; if killed it takes long to come back. He tells Zara, 'I haven't been human for twenty years... I don't belong on Earth anymore.'
386.name: Jason's 'not human' and domain limits

For example [Might]+[any element]+[any weapon] has a very strong chance of producing the Avatar confluence and no one is sure why. Theories range from embodying cosmic beings to ancient heroes to dead gods, but no one has definitive answers, except perhaps the gods, and they aren't talking. On the opposite end the balance essence can deal with more tangible forces such as with the combination Balance + Moon + Sun = Eclipse, where the balance essence acts to enable synergy between the Moon and Sun essences. 416.content: Desolate essence: confluence essence. The Desolate essence, like all confluences, is impacted by the essences that make it up, with the types of abilities it tends to awaken including drain attacks, debuffs and zone spells. Drain attacks include the usual health an mana drain, but Desolate specifically will often have an ability to drain aspects of the environment, depending on the essences that make it up. This is a distinctive traits of the Desolate confluence, where most essences enhance the aspects of the essences that make it up, Desolate often weakens them. Many Desolate combination involve the Death essence and are accordingly restricted. These combinations are usually characterised by the unnatural destruction its abilities cause. Other combinations tend to be related to natural forms of desolation, like deserts. Known combinations: Sand + Wind + Sun = Desolate - desert combination. Mana drain, stamina drain, withering powers, giant sand worms, sand storms.; Ice + Earth + Wind = Desolate - a tundra-themed combination that might include wide area cold and mana burn abilities, possibly with summoning powers for wolf and fox type creatures.; Locust + Plant + Hunger = Desolate - a classic plague of locusts combination that desolates the landscape to grow in power. Not a restricted combination but one looked unfavourably on by local communities, due to the damage it tends to do the the landscape.; Locust + Blood + Hunger= Desolate - also a plague of locusts, but likes steak over salad. This combination is restricted, despite not including any restricted essences. 566.content:
The Adventure Society is one of the major organizations in the world. Its main purpose is to handle monster extermination.
The Adventure Society issues monster notices which can be taken from a notice board or the Adventure Society directly. Each notice has three pieces of information so long as that information is known. The name of the monster, or a description, the number of monsters, and the approximate location.
The first step to joining the adventure society involves registering an application and a physical assessment.  This invoves filling out one's personal details and a magical scan of the applicants physiology and essences with an official from the magic society, adventure society and a clergy member of Knowledge present. The appalicant's aura is read, recorded and their essence combination checked against the restricted list. The applicant is then scheduled for a field assessment.
For the field assessment, the applicant has their physical and essence abilities tested as well as their ability to made good decisions and plan under pressure.
The Adventure Society insignia is a sword and rod across a shield.
Greenstone Branch:
 - Director: Elspeth Arella
 - Deputy Director: Genevieve Picot
 - Official: Vincent Trenslow
 - Official: Albert Bertinelli
566.name: Adventure Society

570.content:
Spirit coins are the currency of Pallimustus. They are a concentrated source of raw magic adventurers can consume to sustain themselves. Is someone consumes a spirit coin that is of a higher rank than they are, all of their attributes are raised to that rank for a short amount of time. After this boost of power, it leaves the consumer exhausted and enervated.
[Lesser Spirit Coin] (iron rank, common):
An impure distillation of raw magic. (currency, crafting material).
Effect: Used to fuel lesser-rank magic items or as a ritual component.
Description: A coin with a washed-out blue colour, with a metallic sheen. It feels like glass to the touch. Usually there is something embossed on the coin. The coins that are generated by Jason's Interface ability have an image of Jason himself, giving a thumb's up. The other side is engraved with text, reading: "PRODUCT OF JASON     G'DAY MATE"
[Silver Spirit Coin] (silver rank, common):
A distilled quantity of raw magic. (crafting material, currency).
Effects::
 - Used to fuel silver-rank magic items or as a ritual component.
 - Consume to briefly increase all attributes to silver rank.
570.name: Spirit Coin

571.content:
[Monster Core]:
Monster cores are a fairly common drop item, especially with looting abilities. They are used as a part of magic rituals, both as consumed components and as a means to balance out ambient magic. The process of balancing out ambient magic is noted as being difficult especially when multiple rituals are performed in sequence.
They are also used as a means to level up essence user abilities. This process leads to faster early ranks, while stifling later progression. Many nobles and non-adventurers take this route in order to gain the longevity of higher ranks without the physical effort and peril that comes with natural progression. 
System Message:
The magic core of a lesser monster (crafting material, magic core) 
Effect: Common component for ritual magic and magic item creation 
Description: A small, red-brown gem, in the shape of a teardrop.
571.name: Monster Core

572.content:

These cores may be absorbed, like monster cores, to sustain and increase the strength of Essence users. They were required to sustain Gold Rank (Tier-4) essences users that were kept in suspended animation due to Earth's originally low mana levels.
Reality Cores are also used by the Cabal to make Blue Blood.

576.content:
Ability: [Spirit Domain]
This ability is evolved from the ability [Spirit Vault]. This is a secondary gift evolution.
 - You have a dimensional storage space.
 - You may call up a gate and physically enter your dimensional storage space. Only those you allow may enter; others cannot forcibly intrude. You may directly portal from within the storage space to another area using the location of the gate as a starting point, even if the gate is obstructed or destroyed, preventing ordinary egress.
 - You may summon familiars within the storage space without the use of a ritual, although any material requirements of the ritual must still be consumed.
 - You may create spirit domains that reflect your nature and power. The maximum total size of your spirit domains created through this ability is a factor of your rank and soul strength. You may not convert existing spirit domains into your own.
 - You have established a permanent spirit domain. The maximum total area your spirit domains can cover is limited by your soul strength and your rank. Current amount of maximum spirit domain established: 3266%. Increase your rank to increase your maximum total spirit domain size.
 - This spirit domain has a connected astral space. The astral space gains the full effects of your spirit domain but does not count against your maximum spirit domain size. The portals in the [Arrival Pagoda] connecting to various locations in the astral space are now active.
576.name: Spirit Domain

577.content:
Akashic Speech is a method of communication useable to its full extents only by transcendents. It is described by Carlos Quilido as being understood not by the mind but by the soul. However; without an understanding of ones own perceptions it seems to take the form of the language or method of communication most comfortable for the recipient.
Jason gains the ability to properly utilize Akashic Speech through his Numen ability.
Non-Transcendent Use:
It is mentioned by Shade that Akashic is his native language
Jason Asano's Mark of Sin affliction marks the target with the Akashic symbol of "Sin".
The Swords Dread Salvation, Hegemon's Will, and the swords conjured by Jason's Blade of Doom ability are engraved with Akashic symbols.
System Information:
Help: [Akashic Speech]:
Akashic Speech taps into the fundamental interconnectedness of all things in the cosmos to communicate in a way that is intrinsically understood by all things capable of communication. Despite the term ‘speech,' this ability impacts all forms of communication, and is perceived by all entities in the form most natural to them. Full use of this ability is only capable by transcendent entities. Mortal limitations limit the effectiveness of this capability.
Citation:
577.name: Akashic Speech

578.content:
Transcendence:
Transcendence is a state of true immortality outside of normal mortal power. There are many ways to gain transcendence; however the most common are ascending at the peak of mortal power or coming into being as such, embodying a principle of the world or universe.
Although not the only ones to wield it, Trancendents deal primarily in Authority as a means of exchange between each other, in addition to allowing Trancendents to influence the world beyond themselves.
Transcendent Beings:
Gods:
Gods are of individual worlds but not existing within it. Each god exists as an embodiment of a certain principle or concept. As gods are of individual worlds they are unable to see or act beyond that world, leaving astral spaces and the larger astral beyond their reach.
Unlike other transcendents Gods are able to create Divine versions of Essences and Awakening Stones and freely take or seal away those they have gifted.
The vessels of gods speak with power that feels backed by authority which is known as Akashic Speech. This method of communication is intrinsically understood by all things capable of communication. It is described as if the soul is what was listening.
Great Astral Beings:
Great Astral Being exist in the astral between realities as embodiments of various concepts and ideals and bound by the Cosmic Throne.
578.name: Transcendent Beings

579.content:
What Are Astral Kings:
Astral kings are immortal beings that rule their own universe. Their rule is complete, being able to completely change its physics or magical properties, including if the beings inside can be killed or not (completely stopping death, if the astral king wishes so). An Astral King's universe is usually comprised of at least 1 solar system with some planets. 
Prerequisites:
 - Transcendence
 - Gestalt body (merge soul and physical body)
 - Soul realm
 - Astral Throne: 
 - Astral Gate: 
 - Soul Forge: 
Old Text:
To be an Astral King, one must possess an astral throne, a realm located in the astral. The means to acquire a throne are unknown, but Jason obtained his by breaking the bridge. Astral Kings can also have astral gates, which grant them the ability to draw near-infinite power from the astral realm. Jason is just beginning to tap into this power, as his body cannot yet handle it. Additionally, kings can possess soul forges, which are very rare and have the ability to modify souls. This is all that we know about the items they can have, but there may be more that we do not yet understand. There is also a group of Astral Kings that created the species known as the Messengers.
579.name: Astral Kings

580.content:
The Builder is a Great Astral Being who is obsessed with physical reality while, at its core nature, being unable to co-exist with it. It is building a world of its own, creating a new physical reality in the deep astral. It does this by taking raw materials from astral spaces that are neither fully of the astral or of physical reality. By giving an astral space the ability to sustain itself, even if just for a brief period, the Builder can take it and anchor it to the world it is creating from stolen parts. Since a Great Astral Being cannot interact with physical reality directly, it needs to recruit others to act for it. The Builder recruits people to carve off astral spaces connected to their world, then steps in and claims them.
Shako was the primary vessel for the Builder.
Landemere Vane was a Builder cultist.
Thadwick Mercer, Jonah Geller and three others were infected by Star Seeds supplied by the Builder.
Clockwork Kings are the source of clockwork cores that are utilized in the making of the Builder cult constructs.
The Builder was ascended to its position at 16 after the original Builder was removed.
The messenger who ascended to the position of The Builder was called Zithis Carrow Vayel
It Is unknown what happened to the original builder after he was removed from his position  since Astral beings can not die at all
580.name: The Builder

581.content:
The Celestial Book is a Great Astral Being who promotes the understanding of magic's underlying nature.
Clive Standish venerates it, as do many of those heavily involved in magical theory.
581.name: The Celestial Book

The Keeper is the Great Astral Being that governs the flow of time. Ensuring the natural flow of time between universes. It is stated by shade that not even the Keeper can affect the past. It is unclear if this is due to limitations placed on it by The Sundered Throne or the nature of time. Clive's speculation about time travel when discussing dimensional travel is the primary source of the lack of clarity.
The Keeper claims no single name, preferring to not be discussed. Although Raythe the current Prime Vessel prefers "The Keeper of Sands" due to the hourglass imagery.

The Nameless are Astral Beings that are more numerous than the Great Astral Being and serve as functionaries. As the title/name implies they do not have names of their own. It is unknown how many exist but believed to be a in great numbers.
During the Battle of to rebuild the The Sundered Throne the nameless sided with the The World-Phoenix to stop Jason Asano.

The Reaper is a Great Astral Being who advocates for the finality of death.

Emir Bahadir and Rufus Remore are investigating the order. Jason Asano and Sophie Wexler practice a martial art called the Way of the Reaper, which was given to the assassin order by the Reaper.
Shade is The Reaper's shadow and/or child.
There is a cult of the reaper and an order of the reaper (assassins) which is a separated faction.

Gordon is from the realm of The All-Devouring Eye and Colin is from where they border with The Legion. The All-Devouring Eye is not known for handing out blessings.

Hero, as the name suggests, is the god of hero's. He has no subordinate gods.
He appears to those that have decide to make the ultimate sacrifice and offer them the cup of heroes to drink from, this allows those that drink a portion of his transcendent power. This power changes the drinker into a demi god increasing their rank and giving the drinker divine versions of their essences but changes the Confluence essence to the "Hero" essence. For many though seeing Hero will be their worst day for while the power is massive it will inevitably kill them for their bodies cannot handle the power he give them to save lives, thus they will be told by hero how long they have left to live. Hero has seen untold heroes who names wont be remembered by the wider world for the actions only by himself and his priests. Hero informed Jason Asano that there where 3 occasions that the cup could have been offered to him if his intentions were different or had hero been able to see Jason.

590.content:
Healer is the god of medicine and healing. He believes that all should be made well and prosper.
While his temple in Greenstone was corrupt and needed correcting via direct divine intervention (with most of the prior clergy going to the service of Dominion), in general the church values those who wish to heal others, and work with such individuals to further aid them. In addition, the clergy contains specialized healers that make themselves available to those in need.
After the revelations about the church of Purity, the church of Healer has taken over the primary role in expunging Star Seed and healing soul damage done by The Builder.

Dominion:
Dominion is a god of the world and those that rule it. Their clergy serves them, rather than worshipping them. They demand obedience from their clergy.
They give the divine right to rule to the kings and emperors. They also like Jason Asano and Gary, and want to see what it takes to make them kneel.
Dominion replaced the essences and awakening stones of a number of priests of the Healer, who were cast out by their god for aggrandizing themselves and demanding money to perform healing.

Goddess of Knowledge

593.content:
Purity (see also: Disguise) was one of the gods in the world of Pallimustus. Approximately 500 years prior to the start of the events of the book series, Purity sanctioned itself, expending all of its authority to create a single artifact. This appears to be the end of Purity as a god. However, the Church of Purity continued to function, and a god claiming to be Purity stepped in to continue dominion over Purity's temples and people. 
Over the course of 500 years, changes were introduced into Purity's doctrine which emphasized zealotry and militant groups, such as the Order of Redeeming Light. Additionally, humans began to be perceived as the "pure" state by these groups, undergoing rituals that stripped other races of their identity and causing changes in them that caused identification magic to perceive them as human - perpetuating a sense of superiority among humanity. 
After a series of inconsistencies in Purity's actions, such as overtly allying with the cultists of The Builder and the discovery that the purification ritual of the Order of Redeeming Light was a modified vampiric curse, Carlos Quilido comes to the realization that Purity is a fraud. In conversation with Jason Asano, Quilido initially hypothesized that Purity could be any of the trickster gods - Deceit or Disguise as frontrunners. Once this information becomes more widely known, Disguise gives up the pretense and reveals itself to have been masquerading as Purity.
593.name: Purity

596.content:
Vampires are entities that feed off of others. They come in a variety of forms.
 - Greater vampires are individuals who volunteered to be turned and had their souls altered by the process. They can get a variety of powers depending on their bloodline, and can create lesser vampires. They are weakened, harmed, and slowly driven insane by magical sunlight, depending on their rank and the level of magic in the sunlight. Greater vampires appear to be more common on Earth than Pallimustus . This is due to potent vampiric bloodlines manifesting on Earth as a result of patterns placed into the seed of that universe by the Builder, and possibly the low mana saturation and density leaving sunlight less damaging to greater vampires' power and sanity.
 - *The Cabal contains a large number of the Greater Vampires on Earth.
 - Essence user vampires are created by an essence user forming specific varieties of the Undeath confluence essence (often, if not always, involving the blood essence).
 - Lesser vampires are created by greater vampires and some types of monsters (possibly some death essence powers as well). They can be cured if the victim is cleansed before their body is altered too much by the curse.
 - Blood servants are not technically vampires, but are people who consumed vampire blood, strengthening them. Not only is it addictive but they lose their strength if they don't regularly consume more vampire blood.
596.name: Vampires

597.content:
The Network is a coalition of local organizations using "new" magic more commonly called Essences user or as onboard earth Essences magicians. It was the strongest of the three magical factions on Earth only recently overtaking the Cabal in the last century before fracturing during the Reality Cores crisis. It is made up of unranked Humans, Essences users, Transformed, and Enhanced humans. Even Fractured they remain one of the most predominant factions on Earth.
History:
The first local branches where set up by a Gold ranked Outworlder known as The Founder who originated from Earth but became an Outworlder after traveling to Pallimustus and returning to Earth While on Pallimustus the Outworlder made a deal with a God before returning to Earth. Upon returning, they began setting up small local Network branches around the world. These local networks worked in secret beginning as secret societies. These secret societies hid the existence of magic and of monsters as apart of their core tenets. It was during this time that The Founder and his familiar Noreth also created  The Grid which was used by the new Network branches to monitor and control the magic of Earth. This new magic came into conflict this the existing magical beings, the Cabal. The The Founder came into conflict with their familiar North. When the two became  irreconcilable Noreth betrayed his bond to the American branch, which gave them a considerable head start.
597.name: The Network

604.content:
Within the universe of He Who Fights With Monsters, power is measured in layers: mortal, transcendent, divine. Yet even among the unimaginable forces that shape worlds, some creatures stand apart as forces of inevitable ruin. These are the apocalypse beasts—entities whose very existence embodies catastrophe. Unlike ordinary monsters, apocalypse beasts are not simply predators or conquerors. They are living disasters, their nature so overwhelming that their presence can alter or even erase entire worlds.
The defining trait of an apocalypse beast is not only its immense strength, but also its purpose. Where most beings pursue survival, growth, or dominion, apocalypse beasts represent cosmic archetypes: hunger without end, destruction as rebirth, infestation as inevitability. They are more concept than creature, and each encounter with them serves as a reminder that in Jason Asano's world, the universe itself can create monstrosities that embody annihilation.
Only a few Beasts have so far been discussed as most encounters lead to a horrific end. Even races such as the messengers have had to retreat in the face beasts that have grew to full power, while using others as Doomsday weapons when invading planets 
Know Apocalypse beasts so far are listed below:

Soul Crest:
Created by a highly skilled magical tattoo artist, using an Immortal Crest as part of the ritual, Soul Crests imprint upon the user. This creates an aspect of their aura that is unique, while also drawing out a mark on their body in the form of a tattoo. Though based almost entirely upon the soul-deep nature of a person, it is also lightly shaped by the tattooist's own style. As such, some have been embarrassed by the tattoo showing their true nature, and not the one they portray. While the visible form is mutable to changes such as soul scarring events, once its mark on the user's aura signature is registered with the Adventure Society, a Soul Crest cannot be faked or mimicked by any known method, including shapeshifters, serving as iron-clad proof of identity anywhere on Palimustus.
Most of those who possess an Immortal Crest come from backgrounds of wealth and power, such as Humphrey Geller, as they are expensive and difficult to produce, while only usable at Iron Rank. Exceptions include when Immortal Crests are generated by looting powers, as in the case of Jason Asano, though this is noted as highly unusual by Tilly, the artist who applied Jason's crest.

617.content:
System Information:
Item: [Jason's Lemonade] (normal rank, common):
A delicious citrus drink (consumable, beverage).
Effect: Refreshing.
Crafting Requirements:
Materials::
 - 6 lemons.
 - 1 and ¼ cups of sugar.
 - 5 cups of water.
Amounts of sugar and lemon juice can be adjusted, if you like it extra sweet or with bit of a twang to it.
Tools::
 - Mixing bowl.
 - Cooking pot.
 - Mesh strainer.
 - Lemon/vegetable peeler.
 - Lemon juicer (optional).
 - Serving pitcher.
Steps:
# Wash lemons. If they feel waxy, scrub them under hot water.
# Peel the zest from 6 lemons with a veggie peeler. You want the yellow zest, but don't be too worried about getting some of the white. Set the peeled lemons aside.
# Cover the lemon zest with 1 and a quarter cup of sugar in a mixing bowl and combine by tossing. Cover with some cling wrap and leave for at least 2 hours, but longer is better. Leaving them overnight works very nicely.
# Bring 5 cups of water to the boil, in a pot on high heat. Turn off heat and pour in lemon-sugar mix.
# Bring water to a boil in a pot over high heat; turn off heat and add the lemon-sugar mixture, including the peel. Stir, then leave as the sugars dissolve, which should be about 5 minutes.
# Strain the liquid back into the mixing bowl through a mesh strainer to excise the peel.
# Do not add the lemon juice immediately. Let the liquid sit until room temperature; about half an hour should do.
617.name: Jason's Lemonade
